label.devLabel: Select the bodies to evaluate and then set the analysis options.
label.translation: Select the bodies to evaluate and then set the analysis options.

label.devLabel: Right click on the canvas image in the browser and select the Calibrate tool to set a specific distance between two points. This will resize the image based on that distance.
label.translation: Right click on the canvas image in the browser and select the Calibrate tool to set a specific distance between two points. This will resize the image based on that distance.

label.devLabel: Select a face or plane then select an image to import. Select display through to see the image through the model and use as a reference.
label.translation: Select a face or plane then select an image to import. Select display through to see the image through the model and use as a reference.

label.devLabel: Use the manipulators to move, scale, rotate, and flip the image. Selecting Chain Faces will allow you to span the image across multiple faces.
label.translation: Use the manipulators to move, scale, rotate, and flip the image. Selecting Chain Faces will allow you to span the image across multiple faces.

label.devLabel: Select a face then select an image to import. Use PNGs to retain background transparency.
label.translation: Select a face then select an image to import. Use PNGs to retain background transparency.

label.devLabel: Hide everything that cannot currently be selected.
label.translation: Hide everything that cannot currently be selected.

label.devLabel: Advances all components in the assembly with their latest changes, even if those changes are not versions.
label.translation: Advances all components in the assembly with their latest changes, even if those changes are not versions.

label.devLabel: Moves an object (component, body, sketch, work geometry) by aligning geometry selected from the object with geometry selected elsewhere. Geometry can be a point, line, plane, circle, or coordinate system. Snaps are treated as full coordinate systems for full position and orientation alignment.
label.translation: Moves an object (component, body, sketch, work geometry) by aligning geometry selected from the object with geometry selected elsewhere. Geometry can be a point, line, plane, circle, or coordinate system. Snaps are treated as full coordinate systems for full position and orientation alignment.

label.devLabel: Select the point on the object to move then select the point on the face to align to. Click Flip and Angle to rotate the object.
label.translation: Select the point on the object to move then select the point on the face to align to. Click Flip and Angle to rotate the object.

label.devLabel: Hold Shift to disable snapping. Hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (Mac) to lock snaps on a face.
label.translation: Hold Shift to disable snapping. Hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (Mac) to lock snaps on a face.

label.devLabel: Select the point on the object to move then select the point on the face to align to. Click Flip and Angle to rotate the object.
label.translation: Select the point on the object to move then select the point on the face to align to. Click Flip and Angle to rotate the object.

label.devLabel: Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) note for a hole or boss, with or without threads.
label.translation: Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) note for a hole or boss, with or without threads.

label.devLabel: Add a leader line and include units, diameter, depth, thread information, tolerance, and text. The information stays with the feature and can be reused in downstream manufacturing workflows, such as automated hole drilling.
label.translation: Добавьте выносную линию и включите единицы измерения, диаметр, глубину, информацию о резьбе, допуски и текст. Эта информация остается с объектом и может быть повторно использована в последующих производственных процессах, таких как автоматическое сверление отверстий.

label.devLabel:
Select a hole or boss in the canvas to attach the PMI note.
When multiple matching holes or bosses are included, this controls which one the PMI note is visually attached to.
label.translation:
Выберите отверстие или выступ на холсте для привязки заметки PMI.
При включении нескольких совпадающих отверстий или выступов эта опция определяет, к какому из них визуально привязывается заметка PMI.

label.devLabel: Assigns appearances to components, bodies, or faces in a design to override the color and texture of their physical materials, without affecting physical engineering properties.
label.translation: Assigns appearances to components, bodies, or faces in a design to override the color and texture of their physical materials, without affecting physical engineering properties.

label.devLabel: Choose whether to apply appearances to components and bodies or specific faces, then drag appearances onto components, bodies, or faces in the canvas or the Browser. In the In This Design section, right-click appearances to edit, duplicate, delete, or add them as favorites.
label.translation: Выберите, применять ли материалы к компонентам и телам или к конкретным граням, а затем перетаскивайте материалы на компоненты, тела или грани на холсте или в браузере. В разделе "В этом проекте" щелкните правой кнопкой мыши материалы, чтобы изменить их, скопировать, удалить или добавить в избранное.

label.devLabel: Right-click the appearance swatch in the In This Design section to edit, duplicate, and access other options.
label.translation: Right-click the appearance swatch in the In This Design section to edit, duplicate, and access other options.

label.devLabel: Drag the appearance from the dialog to the body, component, or face.
label.translation: Drag the appearance from the dialog to the body, component, or face.

label.devLabel: Creates an arc using three points.
label.translation: Creates an arc using three points.

label.devLabel: Select the center point, then select start point and last select the end point or specify an angle value.
label.translation: Select the center point, then select start point and last select the end point or specify an angle value.

label.devLabel: Creates an arc using three points.
label.translation: Creates an arc using three points.

label.devLabel: Select the start point, end point, and then a point on the arc.
label.translation: Select the start point, end point, and then a point on the arc.

label.devLabel: Quickly arrange items on a plane or sketch for manufacturing.
label.translation: Quickly arrange items on a plane or sketch for manufacturing.

label.devLabel: Constrain geometry to position two or more components relative to each other, reduce degrees of freedom in the assembly, and create a Constraint Relationship between the components.
label.translation: Constrain geometry to position two or more components relative to each other, reduce degrees of freedom in the assembly, and create a Constraint Relationship between the components.

label.devLabel: To create a constraint, select faces, edges, or vertexes on two components so they are flush, coincident, concentric, or at an angle. Then specify an offset distance or angle. Optionally, add more constraints to build up a set.
label.translation: Чтобы создать ограничение, выберите грани, ребра или вершины на двух компонентах так, чтобы они были совмещены, совпадали, были концентричны или находились под углом. Затем укажите расстояние смещения или угол. При необходимости добавьте дополнительные ограничения для создания набора.

label.devLabel: Displays Assembly Statistics of the Assembly.
label.translation: Displays Assembly Statistics of the Assembly.

label.devLabel: Assign unique item numbers to selected components for tracking throughout their life cycles.
label.translation: Assign unique item numbers to selected components for tracking throughout their life cycles.

label.devLabel: Items are set to “unreleased” and are accessible in Fusion Manage.
label.translation: Items are set to “unreleased” and are accessible in Fusion Manage.

label.devLabel: Generates options using AI technology to automatically dimension and constrain your sketch. Review the proposals and select the one that best suits your needs.
label.translation: Generates options using AI technology to automatically dimension and constrain your sketch. Review the proposals and select the one that best suits your needs.

label.devLabel:
Place a datum point to align the constraints and dimensions to, then AI technology automatically generates options with dimension and constraints added your sketch.
Review the proposals and select the one that best suits your needs.
label.translation: Этот результат применяет ортогональные, касательные, параллельные, совпадающие и концентрические ограничения к геометрии эскиза в пределах допуска, который вы указываете с помощью ползунка Допуск и пользовательских настроек

label.devLabel: You can also set a datum in your sketch to drive consistency and accuracy. A datum is a point used as a reference for calculating and generating all the dimensions and constraints in your sketch. Set one by going to a Result tile, clicking the More menu, and then clicking Set datum. The dimensions and constraints are then updated using the datum as the reference point.
label.translation: You can also set a datum in your sketch to drive consistency and accuracy. A datum is a point used as a reference for calculating and generating all the dimensions and constraints in your sketch. Set one by going to a Result tile, clicking the More menu, and then clicking Set datum. The dimensions and constraints are then updated using the datum as the reference point.

label.devLabel: Place a datum point to align the constraints and dimensions to, then AI technology automatically generates options with dimension and constraints added your sketch. Review the proposals and select the one that best suits your needs.
label.translation: Place a datum point to align the constraints and dimensions to, then AI technology automatically generates options with dimension and constraints added your sketch. Review the proposals and select the one that best suits your needs.

label.devLabel: You can also set a datum in your sketch to drive consistency and accuracy. A datum is a point used as a reference for calculating and generating all the dimensions and constraints in your sketch. Set one by going to a Result tile, clicking the More menu, and then clicking Set datum. The dimensions and constraints are then updated using the datum as the reference point.
label.translation: You can also set a datum in your sketch to drive consistency and accuracy. A datum is a point used as a reference for calculating and generating all the dimensions and constraints in your sketch. Set one by going to a Result tile, clicking the More menu, and then clicking Set datum. The dimensions and constraints are then updated using the datum as the reference point.

label.devLabel: Generates options using AI technology to automatically dimension and constrain your sketch. Review the proposals and select the one that best suits your needs.
label.translation: Generates options using AI technology to automatically dimension and constrain your sketch. Review the proposals and select the one that best suits your needs.

label.devLabel: Generates design alternatives between geometries in space that you want to connect.
label.translation: Разделить целевые грани путем расширения выбранных граней, рабочих плоскостей или выдавливания выбранных эскизов

label.devLabel: Select at least two faces to connect. Optionally, you can select areas where you don't want to create new geometry. The alternatives are generated automatically. Explore them and select the alternative that best suits your needs.
label.translation: Select at least two faces to connect. Optionally, you can select areas where you don't want to create new geometry. The alternatives are generated automatically. Explore them and select the alternative that best suits your needs.

label.devLabel: Select an image to import then position and scale the image. Select display through to see the image through the model and use as a reference.
label.translation: Select an image to import then position and scale the image. Select display through to see the image through the model and use as a reference.

label.devLabel: Enters direct editing mode and inserts a history-free feature in the timeline. Actions performed while in the Base Feature are not recorded in the timeline.
label.translation: Enters direct editing mode and inserts a history-free feature in the timeline. Actions performed while in the Base Feature are not recorded in the timeline.

label.devLabel: Select Finish Base Feature to exit out of the mode.
label.translation: Select Finish Base Feature to exit out of the mode.

label.devLabel: Hide everything that is currently selected.
label.translation: Hide everything that is currently selected.

label.devLabel: Hide everything that is not currently selected.
label.translation: Hide everything that is not currently selected.

label.devLabel: Creates a tangent or curvature continuous blend curve between the endpoints of two sketch curves or edges.
label.translation: Creates a tangent or curvature continuous blend curve between the endpoints of two sketch curves or edges.

label.devLabel: Select two sketch curves or edges in the canvas to blend.
label.translation: Select two sketch curves or edges in the canvas to blend.

label.devLabel: Breaks a sketch entity into two or more segments where it intersects other sketch entities.
label.translation: Breaks a sketch entity into two or more segments where it intersects other sketch entities.

label.devLabel: Pause the cursor over the sketch entity to preview where it will be broken, then click to break it.
label.translation: Pause the cursor over the sketch entity to preview where it will be broken, then click to break it.

label.devLabel: The COM calculation can add to calculation time for other commands. Turn off the visibility of the center of mass node in the browser to exclude it from other calculations. The COM will be recalculated when the visibility is toggled on.
label.translation: Расчёт центра масс (COM) может увеличить время вычислений для других команд. Отключите видимость узла центра масс в браузере, чтобы исключить его из других расчётов. Центр масс будет пересчитан при повторном включении видимости.

label.devLabel: Select components and bodies to include. The center of mass is displayed after you click OK.
label.translation: Select components and bodies to include. The center of mass is displayed after you click OK.

label.devLabel: Bevels the edges of a solid or surface body by removing material from exterior edges or adding material to interior edges.
label.translation: Bevels the edges of a solid or surface body by removing material from exterior edges or adding material to interior edges.

label.devLabel: Select edges, faces, or features, then specify one distance, two distances, or a distance and an angle.
label.translation: Select edges, faces, or features, then specify one distance, two distances, or a distance and an angle.

label.devLabel: Creates a chamfer at the vertex, intersection, or apparent intersection of two lines in a sketch, based on a single distance and an angle.
label.translation: Creates a chamfer at the vertex, intersection, or apparent intersection of two lines in a sketch, based on a single distance and an angle.

label.devLabel: Select a vertex or two lines, then specify the distance and angle values for the chamfer.
label.translation: Select a vertex or two lines, then specify the distance and angle values for the chamfer.

label.devLabel: Creates a chamfer at the vertex, intersection, or apparent intersection of two lines in a sketch, based on a different distance to each side.
label.translation: Creates a chamfer at the vertex, intersection, or apparent intersection of two lines in a sketch, based on a different distance to each side.

label.devLabel: Select a vertex or two lines, then specify the two distance values for the chamfer.
label.translation: Select a vertex or two lines, then specify the two distance values for the chamfer.

label.devLabel: Creates a chamfer at the vertex, intersection, or apparent intersection of two lines in a sketch, based on an equal distance to each side.
label.translation: Creates a chamfer at the vertex, intersection, or apparent intersection of two lines in a sketch, based on an equal distance to each side.

label.devLabel: Select a vertex or two lines, then specify the distance value for the chamfer.
label.translation: Select a vertex or two lines, then specify the distance value for the chamfer.

label.devLabel: Chamfers are applied to all edges of a selected face or feature. The Two Distance type lets you specify a different distance for each side of the chamfer, and flip them as needed. The Distance and Angle type lets you specify a single distance and an angle to control the form of the chamfer.
label.translation: Фаски применяются ко всем ребрам выбранной грани или элемента. Тип <b>Два расстояния</b> позволяет задать разное расстояние для каждой стороны фаски и при необходимости поменять их местами. Тип <b>Расстояние и угол</b> позволяет задать одно расстояние и угол для управления формой фаски.

label.devLabel: If you need to apply chamfers of different types and sizes, you can create multiple selection sets within the dialog, then adjust the settings for each selection set separately.
label.translation: If you need to apply chamfers of different types and sizes, you can create multiple selection sets within the dialog, then adjust the settings for each selection set separately.

label.devLabel: Displays the Parameters dialog, where you can create and manage equations and relationships to control the size of objects.
label.translation: Displays the Parameters dialog, where you can create and manage equations and relationships to control the size of objects.

label.devLabel: Edit the name, expression, and comments for parameters. Create User Parameters to use in other expressions.
label.translation: Edit the name, expression, and comments for parameters. Create User Parameters to use in other expressions.

label.devLabel: Select the curves to pattern then select the center point.
label.translation: Select the curves to pattern then select the center point.

label.devLabel: A pattern glyph is placed at the center of the pattern. Double-click the glyph to edit the pattern.
label.translation: A pattern glyph is placed at the center of the pattern. Double-click the glyph to edit the pattern.

label.devLabel: Creates a circle using a center point and diameter.
label.translation: Creates a circle using a center point and diameter.

label.devLabel: Select to define the center point then specify the diameter.
label.translation: Select to define the center point then specify the diameter.

label.devLabel: Creates an ellipse defined by a center point, major axis and a point on the ellipse.
label.translation: Creates an ellipse defined by a center point, major axis and a point on the ellipse.

label.devLabel: Select the center point of the ellipse. Select the second point to define the first axis. Select the third point to define a point on the ellipse.
label.translation: Select the center point of the ellipse. Select the second point to define the first axis. Select the third point to define a point on the ellipse.

label.devLabel: Creates a circle tangent to two sketch lines.
label.translation: Creates a circle tangent to two sketch lines.

label.devLabel: Select two lines then specify the radius of the circle.
label.translation: Select two lines then specify the radius of the circle.

label.devLabel: Creates a circle defined by three points.
label.translation: Creates a circle defined by three points.

label.devLabel: Specify three points on the circumference of the circle. The points define the size and position of the circle.
label.translation: Specify three points on the circumference of the circle. The points define the size and position of the circle.

label.devLabel: Creates a circle tangent to three sketch lines.
label.translation: Creates a circle tangent to three sketch lines.

label.devLabel: Select three lines that the circle will be tangent to.
label.translation: Select three lines that the circle will be tangent to.

label.devLabel: Creates a circle defined by two points.
label.translation: Creates a circle defined by two points.

label.devLabel: Specify two points on the diameter of the circle.
label.translation: Specify two points on the diameter of the circle.

label.devLabel: Duplicates selected sketch curves in an arc or circular pattern.
label.translation: Duplicates selected sketch curves in an arc or circular pattern.

label.devLabel: Select the curves to pattern, the point to revolve around, and the quantity.
label.translation: Select the curves to pattern, the point to revolve around, and the quantity.

label.devLabel: Joins, cuts, or intersects two or more solid bodies to create a single solid body.
label.translation: Joins, cuts, or intersects two or more solid bodies to create a single solid body.

label.devLabel: Select the target body, select one or more tool bodies to combine with the target body, then select the operation to use to combine the bodies together.
label.translation: Select the target body, select one or more tool bodies to combine with the target body, then select the operation to use to combine the bodies together.

label.devLabel: Check New Component to create a new internal component in the assembly to contain the combined result.
label.translation: Check New Component to create a new internal component in the assembly to contain the combined result.

label.devLabel: Check Keep Tools to preserve a copy of the tool bodies in the design. If the combined result is hidden behind the tool bodies in the canvas, locate the tool bodies in the Browser and hide them.
label.translation: Check Keep Tools to preserve a copy of the tool bodies in the design. If the combined result is hidden behind the tool bodies in the canvas, locate the tool bodies in the Browser and hide them.

label.devLabel: Computes all of the parameters, features, and assembly relationships in a design.
label.translation: Computes all of the parameters, features, and assembly relationships in a design.

label.devLabel: Use at major milestones in the design process and after making significant changes to features in the Timeline, to ensure all assembly relationships are calculated properly.
label.translation: Use at major milestones in the design process and after making significant changes to features in the Timeline, to ensure all assembly relationships are calculated properly.

label.devLabel: Computes only the features related to unresolved external components in the assembly.
label.translation: Computes only the features related to unresolved external components in the assembly.

label.devLabel: Only available when you open a design that contains unresolved external components. You must compute the features related to the unresolved components before you can edit or save the design.
label.translation: Only available when you open a design that contains unresolved external components. You must compute the features related to the unresolved components before you can edit or save the design.

label.devLabel: Creates a curve driven by endpoints and Rho value. Depending on the Rho value, the curve can be elliptical, parabolic, or hyperbolic.
label.translation: Creates a curve driven by endpoints and Rho value. Depending on the Rho value, the curve can be elliptical, parabolic, or hyperbolic.

label.devLabel: Select the start point, end point, and then the top of the vertex. Use the guidelines to create a tangency constraint. Specify the Rho value for the desired shape of the conic curve.
label.translation: Select the start point, end point, and then the top of the vertex. Use the guidelines to create a tangency constraint. Specify the Rho value for the desired shape of the conic curve.

label.devLabel: Creates obstacle geometry bodies in locations of bolts or pins in an assembly.
label.translation: Creates obstacle geometry bodies in locations of bolts or pins in an assembly.

label.devLabel: Customize the size and shape of connector obstacles by adjusting the shaft length and diameter, and clearance for bolt heads, nuts, and tooling.
label.translation: Customize the size and shape of connector obstacles by adjusting the shaft length and diameter, and clearance for bolt heads, nuts, and tooling.

label.devLabel: Select Flip Side to change ends of bolts and tool clearance.
label.translation: Select Flip Side to change ends of bolts and tool clearance.

label.devLabel: On the canvas, select the start and end of the shaft. Select edges or faces. Use manipulators to adjust the shaft diameter and length. To add clearance for bolt heads, select Bolt Head and specify the head diameter and length. To add clearance for a tool, select Tool Clearance and specify the clearance diameter and length.
label.translation: На холсте выберите начало и конец вала. Выберите ребра или грани. Используйте манипуляторы для регулировки диаметра и длины вала. Чтобы добавить зазор для головок болтов, выберите "Головка болта" и укажите диаметр и длину головки. Чтобы добавить зазор для инструмента, выберите "Зазор для инструмента" и укажите диаметр и длину зазора.

label.devLabel: Constrains the position of two points or a point and a line or curve together.
label.translation: Constrains the position of two points or a point and a line or curve together.

label.devLabel: This could be a point constrained along a line, two points constrainted to each other, or a point constrained along a curve.
label.translation: This could be a point constrained along a line, two points constrainted to each other, or a point constrained along a curve.

label.devLabel: Constrains two or more objects so that they share a common line.
label.translation: Constrains two or more objects so that they share a common line.

label.devLabel: This could be a line and a rectangle, where the line and one edge of the rectangle lie along the same line.
label.translation: This could be a line and a rectangle, where the line and one edge of the rectangle lie along the same line.

label.devLabel: Constrains two or more arcs, circles, or ellipses to the same center point.
label.translation: Constrains two or more arcs, circles, or ellipses to the same center point.

label.devLabel: Constrains similar objects so that their sizes are identical. When the size of one object changes, the others adjust, too.
label.translation: Constrains similar objects so that their sizes are identical. When the size of one object changes, the others adjust, too.

label.devLabel: Locks the size and location of a point or object.
label.translation: Locks the size and location of a point or object.

label.devLabel: Constrains a single line, or two points, to lie on either the vertical or horizontal axis, whichever is closer to the current alignment.
label.translation: Constrains a single line, or two points, to lie on either the vertical or horizontal axis, whichever is closer to the current alignment.

label.devLabel: Constrains a point or object to the midpoint of another object.
label.translation: Constrains a point or object to the midpoint of another object.

label.devLabel: Constrains two lines so that they extend in the same direction and never intersect.
label.translation: Constrains two lines so that they extend in the same direction and never intersect.

label.devLabel: Constrains two objects so that they lie perpendicular (at a 90-degree angle) to each other.
label.translation: Constrains two objects so that they lie perpendicular (at a 90-degree angle) to each other.

label.devLabel: Constrains two or more objects to create a smooth, continuous curvature between them (G2 continuity).
label.translation: Constrains two or more objects to create a smooth, continuous curvature between them (G2 continuity).

label.devLabel: Constrains two or more objects so that they are symmetrical (identical to each other in relation to a common axis).
label.translation: Constrains two or more objects so that they are symmetrical (identical to each other in relation to a common axis).

label.devLabel: Constrains a curve and another object so that they touch at a single point but never cross each other.
label.translation: Constrains a curve and another object so that they touch at a single point but never cross each other.

label.devLabel:
To create a Constraint, select faces, edges, or vertexes on two components so they are flush, coincident, concentric, or at an angle. Then specify an offset distance or angle.

Optionally, add more Constraints to build up a set.
label.translation:
Чтобы создать ограничение, выберите грани, ребра или вершины на двух компонентах, чтобы они были совпадающими, концентрическими или под углом. Затем укажите расстояние смещения или угол.

При необходимости добавьте больше ограничений, чтобы создать набор.

label.devLabel: For Align, the way the geometry is constrained depends on the type of geometry you select. For example, a constraint between two cylindrical faces will be concentric.
label.translation: For Align, the way the geometry is constrained depends on the type of geometry you select. For example, a constraint between two cylindrical faces will be concentric.

label.devLabel: Constraints: %1 total (%2 added) Dimensions: %3 total (%4 added)
Creates a Construction Axis along a linear edge or sketch curve.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Axis along a linear edge or sketch curve.

label.devLabel: Select a linear edge, axis or sketch line to place the axis.
label.translation: Select a linear edge, axis or sketch line to place the axis.

label.devLabel: Select a linear edge, axis or sketch line, and a new construction axis is created along it.
label.translation: Select a linear edge, axis or sketch line, and a new construction axis is created along it.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Axis coincident with the intersection of two faces or planes.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Axis coincident with the intersection of two faces or planes.

label.devLabel: Select two faces or planes to create an axis where they intersect.
label.translation: Select two faces or planes to create an axis where they intersect.

label.devLabel: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the axis feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.
label.translation: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the axis feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.

label.devLabel: Select two faces or planes, and a new construction axis is created to pass through each of them.
label.translation: Select two faces or planes, and a new construction axis is created to pass through each of them.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Axis that passes through two points or vertices.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Axis that passes through two points or vertices.

label.devLabel: Select two vertices or sketch points to create a Construction Axis that is coincident with both vertices and points.
label.translation: Select two vertices or sketch points to create a Construction Axis that is coincident with both vertices and points.

label.devLabel: Select two vertices or sketch points, and a new construction axis is created to pass through them.
label.translation: Select two vertices or sketch points, and a new construction axis is created to pass through them.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Axis that is perpendicular to a face and passes through a specific point.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Axis that is perpendicular to a face and passes through a specific point.

label.devLabel: Select a face or plane and a vertex or sketch point to create an axis that is perpendicular to the plane and coincident with the point.
label.translation: Select a face or plane and a vertex or sketch point to create an axis that is perpendicular to the plane and coincident with the point.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Axis through the center of a cylinder, cone or torus.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Axis through the center of a cylinder, cone or torus.

label.devLabel: Select a cylinder, cone, or torus to create an axis through its center.
label.translation: Select a cylinder, cone, or torus to create an axis through its center.

label.devLabel: Select a cylinder, cone or torus, and a new construction axis is created to pass through its center.
label.translation: Select a cylinder, cone or torus, and a new construction axis is created to pass through its center.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Plane at the midpoint between two faces or planes.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Plane at the midpoint between two faces or planes.

label.devLabel: Select two faces or planes to create a Construction Plane between them.
label.translation: Select two faces or planes to create a Construction Plane between them.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Plane normal to an edge or sketch line.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Plane normal to an edge or sketch line.

label.devLabel: Select an edge or sketch line to create a Construction Plane along.
label.translation: Select an edge or sketch line to create a Construction Plane along.

label.devLabel: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the plane feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.
label.translation: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the plane feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.

label.devLabel: Select an edge or sketch line to position the plane along the path.
label.translation: Select an edge or sketch line to position the plane along the path.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Plane through an edge, axis, or line at a specific angle.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Plane through an edge, axis, or line at a specific angle.

label.devLabel: Select a linear edge, axis, or sketch line to position the plane, then specify the rotation angle.
label.translation: Select a linear edge, axis, or sketch line to position the plane, then specify the rotation angle.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Plane that passes through three points or vertices.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Plane that passes through three points or vertices.

label.devLabel: Select three points or vertices to create a Construction Plane through.
label.translation: Select three points or vertices to create a Construction Plane through.

label.devLabel: Select three points or vertices, and a new construction plane is created to pass through them.
label.translation: Select three points or vertices, and a new construction plane is created to pass through them.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Plane that passes through two edges or axes.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Plane that passes through two edges or axes.

label.devLabel: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the plane feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.
label.translation: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the plane feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.

label.devLabel: Select two linear edges, axes or sketch lines, and a new construction plane is created to pass through them.
label.translation: Select two linear edges, axes or sketch lines, and a new construction plane is created to pass through them.

label.devLabel: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the plane feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.
label.translation: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the plane feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.

label.devLabel: Select two faces or planes, and a new construction plane is created between them.
label.translation: Select two faces or planes, and a new construction plane is created between them.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Plane that is offset from the selected face or plane.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Plane that is offset from the selected face or plane.

label.translation: Select a face, plane or sketch profile, then specify the offset distance.

label.devLabel: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the plane feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.
label.translation: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the plane feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.

label.devLabel: Select a face, plane or sketch profile, then specify the offset distance.
label.translation: Select a face, plane or sketch profile, then specify the offset distance.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Plane that is perpendicular to a plane or face.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Plane that is perpendicular to a plane or face.

label.devLabel: Select a plane or face to create a construction plane that is perpendicular to the plane or face. Optionally, select a point or face to refine location.
label.translation: Select a plane or face to create a construction plane that is perpendicular to the plane or face. Optionally, select a point or face to refine location.

label.devLabel: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the plane feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.
label.translation: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the plane feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.

label.devLabel: Select a plane or face to create a construction plane that is perpendicular to the plane or face at the selected point.
label.translation: Select a plane or face to create a construction plane that is perpendicular to the plane or face at the selected point.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Plane that is tangent to a face.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Plane that is tangent to a face.

label.devLabel: Select a face to create a plane tangent to, then select a reference point or face or plane (when cylindrical face is selected) to align to or adjust the angle to rotate the plane around face.
label.translation: Select a face to create a plane tangent to, then select a reference point or face or plane (when cylindrical face is selected) to align to or adjust the angle to rotate the plane around face.

label.devLabel: Select a face to create a plane tangent to, then select a reference point or face or plane (when cylindrical face is selected) to align to or adjust the angle to rotate the plane around face.
label.translation: Select a face to create a plane tangent to, then select a reference point or face or plane (when cylindrical face is selected) to align to or adjust the angle to rotate the plane around face.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Point at a specific distance along the path.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Point at a specific distance along the path.

label.devLabel: Select an edge, sketch line, or curve to use as the path to create the Construction Point along. Optionally, specify a distance to place the point.
label.translation: Select an edge, sketch line, or curve to use as the path to create the Construction Point along. Optionally, specify a distance to place the point.

label.devLabel: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the point feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.
label.translation: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the point feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.

label.devLabel: Select an edge, sketch line or curve to use as a path, then specify the distance, and a new construction point is created at the specified distance along the path.
label.translation: Select an edge, sketch line or curve to use as a path, then specify the distance, and a new construction point is created at the specified distance along the path.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Point at the center of a circle, sphere, or torus.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Point at the center of a circle, sphere, or torus.

label.devLabel: Select a circular face or sketch profile, spherical face, or toroidal face to create a Construction Point at its center.
label.translation: Select a circular face or sketch profile, spherical face, or toroidal face to create a Construction Point at its center.

label.devLabel: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the point feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.
label.translation: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the point feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.

label.devLabel: Select a circular face or sketch profile, spherical face or toroidal face, and a new construction point is created at the center point of the circular or spherical geometry.
label.translation: Select a circular face or sketch profile, spherical face or toroidal face, and a new construction point is created at the center point of the circular or spherical geometry.

label.devLabel: Point At Center Of Circle/Sphere/Torus Information
label.translation: Point At Center Of Circle/Sphere/Torus Information

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Point at the intersection of a linear edge, sketch line, or axis with a face or plane.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Point at the intersection of a linear edge, sketch line, or axis with a face or plane.

label.translation: Select a linear edge, sketch line, or axis and a face or plane to create a Construction Point where they intersect.

label.translation: Select a linear edge, sketch line or axis, then select a face or plane, and a new construction point is created at their intersection or extended intersection.

label.devLabel: Creates a Construction Point at an existing point or vertex.
label.translation: Creates a Construction Point at an existing point or vertex.

label.devLabel: Select a vertex or sketch point to place the Construction Point.
label.translation: Select a vertex or sketch point to place the Construction Point.

label.translation: Select a vertex or sketch point, and a new construction point is created at that point.

label.translation: Creates a Construction Point at the intersection or extended intersection of three non-parallel planes or faces.

label.translation: Select three planes, faces, or sketch profiles to create a Construction Point where they intersect.

label.translation: Select three planes, faces or sketch profiles, and a new construction point is created at their intersection or extended intersection.

label.translation: Creates a Construction Point at the intersection or extended intersection of two edges.

label.translation: Select two edges or sketch lines to create a Construction Point where they intersect.

label.translation: Select two edges or sketch lines, and a new construction point is created at their intersection or extended intersection.

label.devLabel: Creates a contact set between selected components.
label.translation: Creates a contact set between selected components.

label.devLabel: Select the bodies or components to participate in the contact analysis.
label.translation: Select the bodies or components to participate in the contact analysis.

label.devLabel: The selected DXF file contains some unsupported geometry, such as 3D objects. Insert DXF has only inserted layers containing supported 2D geometry. To import a DXF with 3D geometry, use Upload in the Data Panel.
label.translation: The selected DXF file contains some unsupported geometry, such as 3D objects. Insert DXF has only inserted layers containing supported 2D geometry. To import a DXF with 3D geometry, use Upload in the Data Panel.

label.devLabel: The Curvature Comb Analysis command only analyzes edges on bodies. To display a curvature comb on a sketch curve, right-click the sketch curve, then select Toggle Curvature Display.
label.translation: The Curvature Comb Analysis command only analyzes edges on bodies. To display a curvature comb on a sketch curve, right-click the sketch curve, then select Toggle Curvature Display.

label.devLabel: You can analyze the curvature along a single edge or analyze curvature continuity at the transitions between connected edges.
label.translation: You can analyze the curvature along a single edge or analyze curvature continuity at the transitions between connected edges.

label.devLabel: In the Browser, analyses are saved in the Analysis folder, where you can show, hide, and edit each analysis.
label.translation: In the Browser, analyses are saved in the Analysis folder, where you can show, hide, and edit each analysis.

label.devLabel: For Gaussian curvature maps, warm colors indicate positive curvature, green indicates a flat surface, and cool colors indicate negative curvature. For Principal Minimum curvature maps, green regions meet the Maximum Limit threshold and red regions exceed it. For Principal Maximum curvature maps, green regions meet the Minimum Limit threshold and red regions exceed it.
label.translation: Для карт гауссовой кривизны теплые цвета указывают на положительную кривизну, зеленый цвет указывает на плоскую поверхность, а холодные цвета указывают на отрицательную кривизну. Для карт минимальной главной кривизны зеленые области соответствуют порогу максимального ограничения, а красные области превышают его. Для карт максимальной главной кривизны зеленые области соответствуют порогу минимального ограничения, а красные области превышают его.

label.devLabel: Displays Degree of Freedom of each component in the Assembly.
label.translation: Displays Degree of Freedom of each component in the Assembly.

label.devLabel: Permanently deletes selected objects, and everything related to them, from the design. Does not create a feature in the timeline. Deleted objects cannot be restored parametrically.
label.translation: Permanently deletes selected objects, and everything related to them, from the design. Does not create a feature in the timeline. Deleted objects cannot be restored parametrically.

label.devLabel: Select components, bodies, sketches, and construction objects to delete. Use the Remove command to preserve parametric history.
label.translation: Select components, bodies, sketches, and construction objects to delete. Use the Remove command to preserve parametric history.

label.devLabel: Select a constraint or dimension to delete it.

label.translation: Укажите максимальное расстояние между поверхностью исходного тела и поверхностью полигонального тела.

label.devLabel: Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) for dimensions.
label.translation: Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) for dimensions.

label.devLabel: Add linear, angular, radius, or diameter dimensions to the model.
label.translation: Add linear, angular, radius, or diameter dimensions to the model.

label.devLabel: Turns off contact analysis for all component.
label.translation: Turns off contact analysis for all component.

label.devLabel: Click to make the design savable again.
label.translation: Click to make the design savable again.

label.devLabel: You can reserve the design and save pending changes.
label.translation: You can reserve the design and save pending changes.

label.devLabel: One Sketch per Layer mode creates a new sketch for each DXF layer, so this mode does not allow insertion into an existing sketch. Select a plane to place the DXF geometry.
label.translation: One Sketch per Layer mode creates a new sketch for each DXF layer, so this mode does not allow insertion into an existing sketch. Select a plane to place the DXF geometry.

label.devLabel: The selected DXF file does not contain units information. The design's units will be used. You can change this with the Units dropdown.
label.translation: The selected DXF file does not contain units information. The design's units will be used. You can change this with the Units dropdown.

label.devLabel: The selected DXF file uses units not supported by Fusion. The design's units will be used instead. You can change this with the Units dropdown.
label.translation: The selected DXF file uses units not supported by Fusion. The design's units will be used instead. You can change this with the Units dropdown.

label.devLabel: Use draft analysis to evaluate positions for a parting line or to find areas of zero draft or undercuts.
label.translation: Use draft analysis to evaluate positions for a parting line or to find areas of zero draft or undercuts.

label.devLabel: Select the bodies to evaluate and the axis to define the direction. Use the options to refine the gradient display.
label.translation: Select the bodies to evaluate and the axis to define the direction. Use the options to refine the gradient display.

label.devLabel: Applies a fixed or parting line draft angle to planar faces.
label.translation: Applies a fixed or parting line draft angle to planar faces.

label.devLabel: Select a pull direction, parting tool, and faces to draft, then specify the draft angle.
label.translation: Select a pull direction, parting tool, and faces to draft, then specify the draft angle.

label.devLabel: Creates a spline driven by the selected control points.
label.translation: Creates a spline driven by the selected control points.

label.devLabel: Select the first point to start the spline. Select additional points as control points.
label.translation: Select the first point to start the spline. Select additional points as control points.

label.devLabel: Creates a spline driven by the selected control points.
label.translation: Creates a spline driven by the selected control points.

label.devLabel: Select the first point to start the spline. Select additional points as control points.
label.translation: Select the first point to start the spline. Select additional points as control points.

label.devLabel: Recommended for use in the Sculpt workspace
label.translation: Recommended for use in the Sculpt workspace

label.devLabel: Creates an individual sketch point to use as reference geometry.
label.translation: Creates an individual sketch point to use as reference geometry.

label.devLabel: Click in the canvas to create a point. You can snap to the grid or existing geometry. Use sketch points to define construction geometry, position hole features, space points on a spline, or connect lines in 3D space.
label.translation: Click in the canvas to create a point. You can snap to the grid or existing geometry. Use sketch points to define construction geometry, position hole features, space points on a spline, or connect lines in 3D space.

label.devLabel: Select a start and endpoint to define a line segment. Click and drag the endpoint of a segment to define an arc.
label.translation: Select a start and endpoint to define a line segment. Click and drag the endpoint of a segment to define an arc.

label.devLabel: Creates a spline through the selected fit points.
label.translation: Creates a spline through the selected fit points.

label.devLabel: Select the first point to start the spline. Select additional points as fit points.
label.translation: Select the first point to start the spline. Select additional points as fit points.

label.devLabel: As a best practice, use the Joint tool in tandem with Duplicate with Joints, rather than As-Built Joint.
label.translation: As a best practice, use the Joint tool in tandem with Duplicate with Joints, rather than As-Built Joint.

label.devLabel: Duplicates components in an assembly and the joints attached to them.
label.translation: Duplicates components in an assembly and the joints attached to them.

label.devLabel: Select components to duplicate, select a Joint Origin Mode, then select a Snap point to place each instance. If a component has multiple joints, select the next row in the selection box, then select a Snap point to place each instance.
label.translation: Выберите компоненты для дублирования, выберите режим происхождения соединения, затем выберите точку привязки для размещения каждого экземпляра. Если у компонента несколько соединений, выберите следующую строку в поле выбора, затем выберите точку привязки для размещения каждого экземпляра.

label.devLabel: Releases the selected components with a change order.
label.translation: Releases the selected components with a change order.

label.devLabel: Includes full audit trail and approval workflow. Internal components and external references are supported.
label.translation: Includes full audit trail and approval workflow. Internal components and external references are supported.

label.devLabel: Control component visibility and transparency during Edit In Place sessions.
label.translation: Control component visibility and transparency during Edit In Place sessions.

label.devLabel: Adjust transparency sliders, visual style, and color overrides to better visualize your design during editing.
label.translation: Adjust transparency sliders, visual style, and color overrides to better visualize your design during editing.

label.devLabel: Select a dimension in the canvas to edit its value.
label.translation: Создает одинаковый отступ с каждой стороны выбранной геометрии.

label.devLabel: Converts the selected face to T-Spline faces, edges, and vertices for modification.
label.translation: Converts the selected face to T-Spline faces, edges, and vertices for modification.

label.devLabel: Select the face to modify. Increase the length and width factors to add faces to give more control.
label.translation: Select the face to modify. Increase the length and width factors to add faces to give more control.

label.devLabel: Use Coordinate Space to control the position of the manipulator. Use Selection Filter to control the types of objects available for selection.
label.translation: Use Coordinate Space to control the position of the manipulator. Use Selection Filter to control the types of objects available for selection.

label.devLabel: Select the face to modify. Increase the length and width factors to add faces to give more control.
label.translation: Select the face to modify. Increase the length and width factors to add faces to give more control.

label.devLabel: Use Edit Initial Position on a component that is ground to parent to edit its position.
label.translation: Use Edit Initial Position on a component that is ground to parent to edit its position.

label.devLabel: Modifies the position of the component when it was created or inserted into the design.
label.translation: Modifies the position of the component when it was created or inserted into the design.

label.devLabel: Raises or recesses a sketch profile relative to faces on a solid body by a specified depth and direction.
label.translation: Raises or recesses a sketch profile relative to faces on a solid body by a specified depth and direction.

label.devLabel: Select sketch profiles, select faces on a solid body to emboss, then adjust depth, effect, and alignment.
label.translation: Select sketch profiles, select faces on a solid body to emboss, then adjust depth, effect, and alignment.

label.devLabel: You can use the Emboss command to wrap text around a curved solid body. Adjust the depth, distance, and rotation angle to fine tune the result.
label.translation: You can use the Emboss command to wrap text around a curved solid body. Adjust the depth, distance, and rotation angle to fine tune the result.

label.devLabel: In parametric designs, emboss features maintain their link to the original sketch. If you edit the sketch, the emboss features created from that sketch will update to reflect the change.
label.translation: In parametric designs, emboss features maintain their link to the original sketch. If you edit the sketch, the emboss features created from that sketch will update to reflect the change.

label.devLabel: Activates contact analysis for all components.
label.translation: Activates contact analysis for all components.

label.devLabel: Activates contact analysis between components in contact sets. Contact sets are managed in the browser.
label.translation: Activates contact analysis between components in contact sets. Contact sets are managed in the browser.

label.devLabel: Click to make the design temporarily read-only for you.
label.translation: Click to make the design temporarily read-only for you.

label.devLabel: Other project members can reserve the design.
label.translation: Other project members can reserve the design.

label.devLabel: Creates the surrounding volume from selected bodies. Surrounding volume can be internal or external to the bodies. The surrounding volume is created in a new component.
label.translation: Creates the surrounding volume from selected bodies. Surrounding volume can be internal or external to the bodies. The surrounding volume is created in a new component.

label.devLabel: Select solid bodies, capping surfaces, or work planes as tools to form the surrounding volume.
label.translation: Select solid bodies, capping surfaces, or work planes as tools to form the surrounding volume.

label.devLabel: Licensing for this product has expired.
label.translation: Licensing for this product has expired.

label.devLabel: Enlarges a surface by extending its edges a specified distance.
label.translation: Enlarges a surface by extending its edges a specified distance.

label.devLabel: Select the edges of a surface, select an extension type, then specify the distance to extend. Select an edge alignment option to control the curvature continuity between faces.
label.translation: Select the edges of a surface, select an extension type, then specify the distance to extend. Select an edge alignment option to control the curvature continuity between faces.

label.devLabel: Extends a curve to the nearest intersecting curve or boundary geometry.
label.translation: Extends a curve to the nearest intersecting curve or boundary geometry.

label.devLabel: Pause the cursor over the curve to preview the portion to be extended. Select the curve to extend it.
label.translation: Pause the cursor over the curve to preview the portion to be extended. Select the curve to extend it.

label.devLabel: Use the Perpendicular extension type to extend a surface 90 degrees from its original angle.
label.translation: Use the Perpendicular extension type to extend a surface 90 degrees from its original angle.

label.devLabel: You can extend edges through another shape and then remove the excess with the Trim command.
label.translation: You can extend edges through another shape and then remove the excess with the Trim command.

label.devLabel: Adds depth to open or closed sketch profiles or faces.
label.translation: Adds depth to open or closed sketch profiles or faces.

label.devLabel: Select an extrusion type, select sketch profiles or faces to extrude, then specify the distance and taper angle. For the Thin Extrude type, specify the wall thickness.
label.translation: Select an extrusion type, select sketch profiles or faces to extrude, then specify the distance and taper angle. For the Thin Extrude type, specify the wall thickness.

label.devLabel: Adjust the Operation setting to control how the extrusion affects your design. You can join, cut, or intersect existing bodies to modify them, create a new body within the same component, or create a new body in a new component.
label.translation:
Управляет допусками для изменения геометрии эскиза.
Альтернативно, настройте каждый допуск индивидуально ниже.

label.devLabel: Select the Thin Extrude type to create a thin wall extrusion along the selected open or closed profile. You can control the wall thickness and location, in addition to the adjustments you can make to a typical area extrusion.
label.translation: Select the Thin Extrude type to create a thin wall extrusion along the selected open or closed profile. You can control the wall thickness and location, in addition to the adjustments you can make to a typical area extrusion.

label.devLabel: Display face groups on mesh bodies to make them easier to work with. Hides component colors, physical materials and appearances.
label.translation: Display face groups on mesh bodies to make them easier to work with. Hides component colors, physical materials and appearances.

label.devLabel: Press Shift+F to show or hide mesh face groups
label.translation: Press Shift+F to show or hide mesh face groups

label.devLabel: Fails to insert this DXF file!
label.translation: Fails to insert this DXF file!

label.devLabel: Displays fastener stacks and their status with respect to engagement settings.
label.translation: Displays fastener stacks and their status with respect to engagement settings.

label.devLabel: Fastener stacks are recognized based on relative spatial placement of fasteners.
label.translation: Fastener stacks are recognized based on relative spatial placement of fasteners.

label.devLabel: Start Insert Similar Fastener, Edit Fastener, Replace Fastener, or Auto Update Size from the Fastener Stack Analysis Browser.
label.translation: Start Insert Similar Fastener, Edit Fastener, Replace Fastener, or Auto Update Size from the Fastener Stack Analysis Browser.

label.devLabel: Analyze inserted fasteners as stacks. Fastener stacks are identified by spatial proximity. The browser lists each stack and its fasteners, and the scene highlights them - green for stacks that meet engagement rules, red for non‑compliant stacks, and blue for stacks you mark as ignored during the fixing workflow.
label.translation: Analyze inserted fasteners as stacks. Fastener stacks are identified by spatial proximity. The browser lists each stack and its fasteners, and the scene highlights them - green for stacks that meet engagement rules, red for non‑compliant stacks, and blue for stacks you mark as ignored during the fixing workflow.

label.devLabel: Inserts a fastener into the active document.
label.translation: Inserts a fastener into the active document.

label.devLabel: Use a combination of searching, filtering and browsing to locate a fastener, adjust the settings, and select a geometry (an edge, a face, a sketch point, an existing fastener) or place a fastener anywhere in the canvas to position it.
label.translation: Use a combination of searching, filtering and browsing to locate a fastener, adjust the settings, and select a geometry (an edge, a face, a sketch point, an existing fastener) or place a fastener anywhere in the canvas to position it.

label.devLabel: Click to expand the list and select a desired fastener. Adjust the fastener settings, such as size or material, and set the position in the active document.
label.translation: Click to expand the list and select a desired fastener. Adjust the fastener settings, such as size or material, and set the position in the active document.

label.devLabel: Places an arc of a specified radius at the intersection of two lines or arcs.
label.translation: Places an arc of a specified radius at the intersection of two lines or arcs.

label.devLabel: Select the vertex or the two lines or arcs. Specify a radius for the fillet.
label.translation: Select the vertex or the two lines or arcs. Specify a radius for the fillet.

label.devLabel: Fillets are applied to all edges of a selected face or feature. The Rule Fillet type only works on faces and features. You can use the Between Faces/Features rule to create fillets at the intersection of separate faces or features.
label.translation: Fillets are applied to all edges of a selected face or feature. The Rule Fillet type only works on faces and features. You can use the Between Faces/Features rule to create fillets at the intersection of separate faces or features.

label.devLabel: If you need to apply fillets of different types and sizes, you can create multiple selection sets within the dialog, then adjust the settings for each selection set separately.
label.translation: If you need to apply fillets of different types and sizes, you can create multiple selection sets within the dialog, then adjust the settings for each selection set separately.

label.devLabel: Identifies features in a body. Recognized features are listed in the browser.
label.translation: Identifies features in a body. Recognized features are listed in the browser.

label.devLabel: Select the bodies then specify the feature types to identify.
label.translation: Select the bodies then specify the feature types to identify.

label.devLabel: Select the bodies then specify the feature types to identify.
label.translation: Select the bodies then specify the feature types to identify.

label.devLabel: Select solid bodies, capping surfaces, or work planes as tools to form the surrounding volume. Select the external shape then set the offset.
label.translation: Select solid bodies, capping surfaces, or work planes as tools to form the surrounding volume. Select the external shape then set the offset.

label.devLabel: Prepares solid or mesh bodies to be 3D printed directly from Fusion's Manufacture workspace or from an external application.
label.translation: Prepares solid or mesh bodies to be 3D printed directly from Fusion's Manufacture workspace or from an external application.

label.devLabel: Select solid or mesh bodies to prepare, then select a Preparation Type to switch to the Manufacture workspace, export and send to an installed 3D printing application, or export a 3MF, STL, or OBJ file. For exports, adjust the output and refinement settings to control the resolution of the mesh.
label.translation: Select solid or mesh bodies to prepare, then select a Preparation Type to switch to the Manufacture workspace, export and send to an installed 3D printing application, or export a 3MF, STL, or OBJ file. For exports, adjust the output and refinement settings to control the resolution of the mesh.

label.devLabel: Select a solid or mesh body in the canvas or browser, then choose a Preparation Type. You can continue in the Manufacture workspace or export the body to a file that you can then open in an external 3D printing application.
label.translation: Select a solid or mesh body in the canvas or browser, then choose a Preparation Type. You can continue in the Manufacture workspace or export the body to a file that you can then open in an external 3D printing application.

label.devLabel: Select a solid or mesh body in the canvas or browser, then choose a Preparation Type. You can continue in the Manufacture workspace or export the body to a file that you can then open in an external 3D printing application.
label.translation: Select a solid or mesh body in the canvas or browser, then choose a Preparation Type. You can continue in the Manufacture workspace or export the body to a file that you can then open in an external 3D printing application.

label.devLabel: Used to colorize an object based on whether or not certain parts of the object are accessible from a particular plane.
label.translation: Used to colorize an object based on whether or not certain parts of the object are accessible from a particular plane.

label.devLabel: Inaccessible areas are highlighted in red. Useful for checking undercut areas through a plane.
label.translation: Inaccessible areas are highlighted in red. Useful for checking undercut areas through a plane.

label.devLabel: Places an image in the 3D space. The image will be placed in the center of current view and is oriented relative to the active camera.
label.translation: Places an image in the 3D space. The image will be placed in the center of current view and is oriented relative to the active camera.

label.devLabel: Select an image to import then position and scale the image.
label.translation: Select an image to import then position and scale the image.

label.devLabel: Places an image on a planar face or sketch plane.
label.translation: Places an image on a planar face or sketch plane.

label.devLabel: Select a face then select an image to import.
label.translation: Select a face then select an image to import.

label.devLabel: Places an image on a selected face as a cosmetic decal.
label.translation: Places an image on a selected face as a cosmetic decal.

label.devLabel: Select a PNG, JPG, or TIF image file from a Fusion project or your local computer. Select a face on a solid or surface body to apply it to, then adjust its orientation, scale, and opacity.
label.translation: Select a PNG, JPG, or TIF image file from a Fusion project or your local computer. Select a face on a solid or surface body to apply it to, then adjust its orientation, scale, and opacity.

label.devLabel: Displays a center mark glyph at the center of mass for the selected objects.
label.translation: Displays a center mark glyph at the center of mass for the selected objects.

label.devLabel: You can measure from the center mark to other objects.
label.translation: You can measure from the center mark to other objects.

label.devLabel: Switches the configured component to a different configuration.
label.translation: Switches the configured component to a different configuration.

label.devLabel: Replaces an external component in an assembly with a different external design.
label.translation: Replaces an external component in an assembly with a different external design.

label.devLabel: In the dialog, navigate to and select a different external design. Check Replace All Instances if you want to replace all identical instances of the selected component in the assembly.
label.translation: In the dialog, navigate to and select a different external design. Check Replace All Instances if you want to replace all identical instances of the selected component in the assembly.

label.devLabel: Creates logical Configuration Rules that drive or limit configured aspect values in a Configured Design, to ensure only valid configurations can be created.
label.translation: Creates logical Configuration Rules that drive or limit configured aspect values in a Configured Design, to ensure only valid configurations can be created.

label.devLabel: Displays a comb with sample points along selected edges of a body to help you analyze the curvature of a surface.
label.translation: Displays a comb with sample points along selected edges of a body to help you analyze the curvature of a surface.

label.devLabel: Select edges to analyze on a body, then adjust the density and scale of the curvature comb.
label.translation: Select edges to analyze on a body, then adjust the density and scale of the curvature comb.

label.devLabel: Displays a color gradient on bodies to help you analyze areas of high and low surface curvature.
label.translation: Displays a color gradient on bodies to help you analyze areas of high and low surface curvature.

label.devLabel: Select bodies to analyze, then select a curvature map type and adjust the display settings of the curvature map.
label.translation: Select bodies to analyze, then select a curvature map type and adjust the display settings of the curvature map.

label.devLabel: Displays a color gradient on the faces of selected bodies to help evaluate the manufacturability of your design.
label.translation: Displays a color gradient on the faces of selected bodies to help evaluate the manufacturability of your design.

label.devLabel: Select the bodies to evaluate and the axis to define the direction. Use the options to refine the gradient display.
label.translation: Select the bodies to evaluate and the axis to define the direction. Use the options to refine the gradient display.

label.devLabel: The pull direction you select sets the direction of the draft. Faces to draft cannot be parallel to the pull direction.
label.translation: The pull direction you select sets the direction of the draft. Faces to draft cannot be parallel to the pull direction.

label.devLabel: To gain more control over the extent of a draft, use the Parting Line draft type and select a plane, face, edge, or sketch curve as a parting tool.
label.translation: To gain more control over the extent of a draft, use the Parting Line draft type and select a plane, face, edge, or sketch curve as a parting tool.

label.devLabel: Rounds the edges of a solid body by adding material to interior edges and removing material from exterior edges.
label.translation: Rounds the edges of a solid body by adding material to interior edges and removing material from exterior edges.

label.devLabel: Select edges, faces, or features, then specify a radius. Use the Rule Fillet type to add fillets based on specified rules. Use the Full Round Fillet type to round the edges over three adjacent faces.
label.translation: Select edges, faces, or features, then specify a radius. Use the Rule Fillet type to add fillets based on specified rules. Use the Full Round Fillet type to round the edges over three adjacent faces.

label.devLabel: The gap fill command can be used to replace surfaces that didn't import into Fusion correctly, or to connect Midsurface shells. Choose between the different fill type operations to create a the desired new surface to fill a gap.
label.translation: The gap fill command can be used to replace surfaces that didn't import into Fusion correctly, or to connect Midsurface shells. Choose between the different fill type operations to create a the desired new surface to fill a gap.

label.devLabel: Fills gaps in surfaces or shells with a new surface.
label.translation: Fills gaps in surfaces or shells with a new surface.

label.devLabel: Creates a view that cuts through all visible objects in a design to reveal interior details and obscured features.
label.translation: Creates a view that cuts through all visible objects in a design to reveal interior details and obscured features.

label.devLabel: Select a planar object to define the cut plane, then adjust the distance and angles to position it in the design. In the Browser, the Section Analysis displays in the Analysis folder, where you can adjust its visibility, edit it, or delete it.
label.translation: Select a planar object to define the cut plane, then adjust the distance and angles to position it in the design. In the Browser, the Section Analysis displays in the Analysis folder, where you can adjust its visibility, edit it, or delete it.

label.devLabel: Creates a hole based on user-specified values and selections.
label.translation: Creates a hole based on user-specified values and selections.

label.devLabel: Select a face to place the hole then select edges to position the hole on the face, or select sketch points to place multiple holes. Specify the hole type, tap type and size values.
label.translation: Select a face to place the hole then select edges to position the hole on the face, or select sketch points to place multiple holes. Specify the hole type, tap type and size values.

label.devLabel: Select the center point of the hole to change the position. When creating tapped or standard clearance holes, the diameter is driven by the Size selected in the Use Standards section.
label.translation: Select the center point of the hole to change the position. When creating tapped or standard clearance holes, the diameter is driven by the Size selected in the Use Standards section.

label.devLabel: Select a face to place the hole then select edges to position the hole on the face, or select sketch points to place multiple holes. Specify the hole type, tap type and size values.
label.translation: Select a face to place the hole then select edges to position the hole on the face, or select sketch points to place multiple holes. Specify the hole type, tap type and size values.

label.devLabel: Inserts the selected component into the current design.
label.translation: Inserts the selected component into the current design.

label.devLabel: Select the component to insert then use the manipulator to adjust the position.
label.translation: Select the component to insert then use the manipulator to adjust the position.

label.devLabel: Applies UV mapping and curvature combs to analyze the quality of a surface.
label.translation: Applies UV mapping and curvature combs to analyze the quality of a surface.

label.devLabel: Select bodies or faces to analyze, select the isocurve type, then adjust the number of isocurves to display. You can also display curvature combs and control their density and scale.
label.translation: Select bodies or faces to analyze, select the isocurve type, then adjust the number of isocurves to display. You can also display curvature combs and control their density and scale.

label.devLabel: Displays colors on the model that represent the minimum radius for the curvature of the concave faces.
label.translation: Displays colors on the model that represent the minimum radius for the curvature of the concave faces.

label.devLabel: Detect the minimum fit for holes and fillets. Useful for determining tool sizes in machining.
label.translation: Detect the minimum fit for holes and fillets. Useful for determining tool sizes in machining.

label.devLabel: Change Transform to Point to Point to move the objects by selecting from and to points rather than entering distances. Check Create Copy option to create a copy of the entity during the move.
label.translation: Change Transform to Point to Point to move the objects by selecting from and to points rather than entering distances. Check Create Copy option to create a copy of the entity during the move.

label.devLabel: Select the object to modify then specify the distance or angle. Use Set Pivot to reposition the manipulator.
label.translation: Select the object to modify then specify the distance or angle. Use Set Pivot to reposition the manipulator.

label.devLabel: After you create components, drag one into another in the browser to create a subassembly.
label.translation: After you create components, drag one into another in the browser to create a subassembly.

label.devLabel: You can create external components to create a distributed assembly, where multiple team members can work simultaneously on different components. Click the Edit in Place icon next to any external component in the browser to edit it in context.
label.translation: You can create external components to create a distributed assembly, where multiple team members can work simultaneously on different components. Click the Edit in Place icon next to any external component in the browser to edit it in context.

label.devLabel: Splits a body using surfaces generated from its silhouette curves.
label.translation: Splits a body using surfaces generated from its silhouette curves.

label.devLabel: Set the view direction by selecting a plane or axis then select the body and choose a split operation.
