label.translation: Set the view direction by selecting a plane or axis then select the body and choose a split operation.

label.devLabel: Modifies the selected geometry using offset, extrude, or fillet commands. The operation depends on the geometry selected.
label.translation: Modifies the selected geometry using offset, extrude, or fillet commands. The operation depends on the geometry selected.

label.devLabel: Creates a thin feature from an open sketch profile, extruded to the nearest faces on a solid body. The rib feature is extruded in a direction parallel to the sketch plane.
label.translation: Creates a thin feature from an open sketch profile, extruded to the nearest faces on a solid body. The rib feature is extruded in a direction parallel to the sketch plane.

label.devLabel: Select an open sketch profile, then specify the thickness.
label.translation: Select an open sketch profile, then specify the thickness.

label.devLabel: Set Extent Type to Distance to specify a custom depth for a rib feature, instead of extending the profile all the way to the nearest faces on a solid body.
label.translation: Set Extent Type to Distance to specify a custom depth for a rib feature, instead of extending the profile all the way to the nearest faces on a solid body.

label.devLabel: Project geometry from other features onto the sketch plane to quickly define the profile to use for the rib, and ensure the rib will update parametrically to reflect future design changes.
label.translation: Project geometry from other features onto the sketch plane to quickly define the profile to use for the rib, and ensure the rib will update parametrically to reflect future design changes.

label.devLabel: Select a mesh body to save as OBJ
label.translation: Select a mesh body to save as OBJ

label.devLabel: The Refinement pulldown contains preconfigured mesh settings. Use the sliders under Refinement Options to customize the mesh settings.
label.translation: The Refinement pulldown contains preconfigured mesh settings. Use the sliders under Refinement Options to customize the mesh settings.

label.devLabel: Select the body to export, set the refinement settings, then select the utility to send the mesh file to.
label.translation: Select the body to export, set the refinement settings, then select the utility to send the mesh file to.

label.devLabel: Select a T-Spline body to save control frame as OBJ
label.translation: Select a T-Spline body to save control frame as OBJ

label.devLabel: Displays the Scripts and Add-Ins dialog box. Create, edit, run, stop, debug and manage Scripts and Add-Ins.
label.translation: Displays the Scripts and Add-Ins dialog box. Create, edit, run, stop, debug and manage Scripts and Add-Ins.

label.devLabel: Selection is always active and the active selection mode displays here.
label.translation: Selection is always active and the active selection mode displays here.

label.devLabel: Hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (MacOS) to add objects to or remove objects from the selection. Change the active selection mode by selecting the mode you want to work with from the menu. Use the selection mode and selection filters to fine tune selection.
label.translation: Hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (MacOS) to add objects to or remove objects from the selection. Change the active selection mode by selecting the mode you want to work with from the menu. Use the selection mode and selection filters to fine tune selection.

label.devLabel: Selects objects enclosed in an irregular (lasso) selection area.
label.translation: Selects objects enclosed in an irregular (lasso) selection area.

label.devLabel: A clockwise boundary shape selects all objects within the boundary. A counterclockwise boundary shape selects all visible objects crossed by the boundary.
label.translation: A clockwise boundary shape selects all objects within the boundary. A counterclockwise boundary shape selects all visible objects crossed by the boundary.

label.devLabel: Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.
label.translation: Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.

label.devLabel: Press and hold the left mouse button and move across objects to select them.
label.translation: Press and hold the left mouse button and move across objects to select them.

label.devLabel: Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.
label.translation: Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.

label.devLabel: Selects objects enclosed in a rectangular selection area.
label.translation: Selects objects enclosed in a rectangular selection area.

label.devLabel: Click and drag from upper-left to lower-right (window selection) to select objects enclosed by the selection boundary. Click and drag from lower-right to upper-left (crossing selection) to select all visible objects the selection boundary intersects and encloses.
label.translation: Click and drag from upper-left to lower-right (window selection) to select objects enclosed by the selection boundary. Click and drag from lower-right to upper-left (crossing selection) to select all visible objects the selection boundary intersects and encloses.

label.devLabel: Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.
label.translation: Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.

label.devLabel:
Use Rounded Shell type to shell complex geometry and create a full or partial outcomes, then use surface tools to modify the geometry.

Select the body in the browser to create a hollow body without removing faces.
label.translation:
Use Rounded Shell type to shell complex geometry and create a full or partial outcomes, then use surface tools to modify the geometry.

Select the body in the browser to create a hollow body without removing faces.

label.devLabel: Select faces then specify a thickness. The selected faces will be removed and the body will become hollow.
label.translation: Select faces then specify a thickness. The selected faces will be removed and the body will become hollow.

label.devLabel: Shows or hides the Configure dialog without entering Configuration Mode.
label.translation: Shows or hides the Configure dialog without entering Configuration Mode.

label.devLabel: Opens the Configuration Table, enters Configuration Mode, and highlights configurable features and objects in the Timeline and Browser.
label.translation: Opens the Configuration Table, enters Configuration Mode, and highlights configurable features and objects in the Timeline and Browser.

label.devLabel: Add Configurations as rows in the table to create different variants of a design. Click highlighted features and objects to add their configurable aspects as columns in the table.
label.translation: Add Configurations as rows in the table to create different variants of a design. Click highlighted features and objects to add their configurable aspects as columns in the table.

label.devLabel: Select the faces to thicken, then specify a thickness value.
label.translation: Select the faces to thicken, then specify a thickness value.

label.devLabel: If necessary, the selected feature is resized to match the selected thread size.
label.translation: If necessary, the selected feature is resized to match the selected thread size.

label.devLabel: Select a cylindrical face then set the thread specifications.
label.translation: Select a cylindrical face then set the thread specifications.

label.devLabel: Creates a thin feature from an open sketch profile, extruded to the nearest faces on a solid body. The web feature is extruded in a direction perpendicular to the sketch plane.
label.translation: Creates a thin feature from an open sketch profile, extruded to the nearest faces on a solid body. The web feature is extruded in a direction perpendicular to the sketch plane.

label.devLabel: Select an open sketch profile, then specify the thickness.
label.translation: Select an open sketch profile, then specify the thickness.

label.devLabel: Set Extent Type to Distance to specify a custom depth for a web feature, instead of extending the profile all the way to the nearest faces on a solid body.
label.translation: Set Extent Type to Distance to specify a custom depth for a web feature, instead of extending the profile all the way to the nearest faces on a solid body.

label.devLabel: Project geometry from other features onto the sketch plane to quickly define the profile to use for the web, and ensure the web will update parametrically to reflect future design changes.
label.translation: Project geometry from other features onto the sketch plane to quickly define the profile to use for the web, and ensure the web will update parametrically to reflect future design changes.

label.devLabel: Displays alternating black and white stripes on a body to help you analyze the curvature of a surface.
label.translation: Displays alternating black and white stripes on a body to help you analyze the curvature of a surface.

label.devLabel: Select bodies to analyze, then adjust the direction, repeats, and opacity of the zebra stripes.
label.translation: Select bodies to analyze, then adjust the direction, repeats, and opacity of the zebra stripes.

label.devLabel: Opens Fusion Manage in your default browser and shows change order information for the currently selected item.
label.translation: Opens Fusion Manage in your default browser and shows change order information for the currently selected item.

label.devLabel: If the current selection is not assigned as an item in Fusion Manage, the list of change orders is shown.
label.translation: If the current selection is not assigned as an item in Fusion Manage, the list of change orders is shown.

label.devLabel: Opens the Fusion Manage Dashboard in your default browser.
label.translation: Opens the Fusion Manage Dashboard in your default browser.

label.devLabel: The Dashboard is a central place where you can access your Fusion Manage information, such as charts and outstanding work.
label.translation: The Dashboard is a central place where you can access your Fusion Manage information, such as charts and outstanding work.

label.devLabel: Opens Fusion Manage in your default browser and shows the Details page for the currently selected item.
label.translation: Opens Fusion Manage in your default browser and shows the Details page for the currently selected item.

label.devLabel: If the current selection is not assigned as an item in Fusion Manage, the list of items and BOMs is shown.
label.translation: If the current selection is not assigned as an item in Fusion Manage, the list of items and BOMs is shown.

label.devLabel: Shows how data elements connect in a visual graph.
label.translation: Shows how data elements connect in a visual graph.

label.devLabel: Double click any subassembly node to explore its connected data.
label.translation: Double click any subassembly node to explore its connected data.

label.devLabel: The Section Color option is set to From Component by default and displays the section view color coded by component. Set it to Custom to switch the entire section view to a single color that you specify.
label.translation: The Section Color option is set to From Component by default and displays the section view color coded by component. Set it to Custom to switch the entire section view to a single color that you specify.

label.devLabel: Create multiple section analyses, then adjust their visibility in the Browser to switch between them.
label.translation: Create multiple section analyses, then adjust their visibility in the Browser to switch between them.

label.devLabel:
Select holes or bosses on the model.
Window selection selects multiple matching holes or bosses. The PMI note appears immediately after selection. If Select all matching items is enabled, additional matching holes or bosses are automatically added. Click in the canvas to anchor the note.
label.translation:
Select holes or bosses on the model.
Window selection selects multiple matching holes or bosses. The PMI note appears immediately after selection. If Select all matching items is enabled, additional matching holes or bosses are automatically added. Click in the canvas to anchor the note.

label.devLabel: Inserts geometry from a DXF file into the active sketch.
label.translation: Inserts geometry from a DXF file into the active sketch.

label.devLabel: Select a face or plane, select the DXF file to insert, then position the geometry on the plane.
label.translation: Select a face or plane, select the DXF file to insert, then position the geometry on the plane.

label.devLabel: Select the unit type that matches the units from the original design that generated the DXF.
label.translation: Select the unit type that matches the units from the original design that generated the DXF.

label.devLabel: Single Sketch mode inserts the DXF geometry into a single sketch. One Sketch per Layer mode creates a separate sketch for each DXF layer. Both modes only insert sketch geometry - solid and surface geometry is not inserted.
label.translation: Single Sketch mode inserts the DXF geometry into a single sketch. One Sketch per Layer mode creates a separate sketch for each DXF layer. Both modes only insert sketch geometry - solid and surface geometry is not inserted.

label.devLabel: Select a face or plane then select the DXF file to insert. Set the position of the geometry on the selected plane.
label.translation: Select a face or plane then select the DXF file to insert. Set the position of the geometry on the selected plane.

label.devLabel: Include edges, work geometry, and sketch curves into the current sketch.
label.translation: Include edges, work geometry, and sketch curves into the current sketch.

label.devLabel: Insert a McMaster-Carr Component into the active document.
label.translation: Insert a McMaster-Carr Component into the active document.

label.devLabel: Browse to the desired component, click the Product Detail CAD icon, select the file type, then click Save.
label.translation: Browse to the desired component, click the Product Detail CAD icon, select the file type, then click Save.

label.devLabel: SAT and STEP files are supported. The selected component is added to the active design as a new component.
label.translation: SAT and STEP files are supported. The selected component is added to the active design as a new component.

label.devLabel: Browse to the desired component, click the Product Detail CAD icon, select the file type, then click Save.
label.translation: Browse to the desired component, click the Product Detail CAD icon, select the file type, then click Save.

label.devLabel: SVG files are inserted as fixed sketch entities in the active design.
label.translation: SVG files are inserted as fixed sketch entities in the active design.

label.devLabel: Select the sketch profile or planar face then select the SVG file to insert. Set the position and the scale.
label.translation: Select the sketch profile or planar face then select the SVG file to insert. Set the position and the scale.

label.devLabel: Reports the interference between selected solid bodies or components.
label.translation: Reports the interference between selected solid bodies or components.

label.devLabel: Select the components then click compute. Choose to create components from the interferences.
label.translation: Select the components then click compute. Choose to create components from the interferences.

label.devLabel: Check Show All Interferences to highlight the geometry that has interferences in the model. Uncheck Show All Intereferences then select individual rows to display that interference.
label.translation: Check Show All Interferences to highlight the geometry that has interferences in the model. Uncheck Show All Intereferences then select individual rows to display that interference.

label.devLabel: Select the components then click Compute to display results.
label.translation: Select the components then click Compute to display results.

label.devLabel: Projects the points, model edges, work geometries, and sketch curves that intersect the active sketch plane.
label.translation: Projects the points, model edges, work geometries, and sketch curves that intersect the active sketch plane.

label.devLabel: Use the selection filter to project specific type of geometry or the entire model.
label.translation: Use the selection filter to project specific type of geometry or the entire model.

label.devLabel: In the selection filter Specified Entities will find the intersection of points, lines, arcs, etc. Bodies will project the entire intersection cut of the object selected.
label.translation: In the selection filter Specified Entities will find the intersection of points, lines, arcs, etc. Bodies will project the entire intersection cut of the object selected.

label.devLabel: Set the selection filter then select the objects to project the intersection of the object and the active sketch.
label.translation: Set the selection filter then select the objects to project the intersection of the object and the active sketch.

label.devLabel: Creates a 3D sketch curve from intersecting geometry.
label.translation: Creates a 3D sketch curve from intersecting geometry.

label.devLabel: The first selection is the sketch curve. The second selection is the sketch curve or faces to intersect with. You can select multiple curves or faces to intersect with.
label.translation: The first selection is the sketch curve. The second selection is the sketch curve or faces to intersect with. You can select multiple curves or faces to intersect with.

label.devLabel: The projected curve and the selected sketch curve cannot be in the same sketch.
label.translation: The projected curve and the selected sketch curve cannot be in the same sketch.

label.devLabel: The first selection is the sketch curve. The second selection is the sketch curve or faces to intersect with. You can select multiple curves or faces to intersect with.
label.translation: The first selection is the sketch curve. The second selection is the sketch curve or faces to intersect with. You can select multiple curves or faces to intersect with.

label.devLabel: Invert the set of hidden selections.
label.translation: Invert the set of hidden selections.

label.devLabel: In the Browser, analyses are saved in the Analysis folder, where you can show, hide, and edit each analysis.
label.translation: In the Browser, analyses are saved in the Analysis folder, where you can show, hide, and edit each analysis.

label.devLabel: Creates a Joint relationship between two components in their current position and defines their relative motion.
label.translation: Creates a Joint relationship between two components in their current position and defines their relative motion.

label.devLabel: Select two components to create a joint between, then specify the motion type and the position of the joint origin. Optionally, specify limits and preview motion.
label.translation: Select two components to create a joint between, then specify the motion type and the position of the joint origin. Optionally, specify limits and preview motion.

label.devLabel: Place the pointer over over a face or edge and press Ctrl (Windows) or Command (Mac) to lock the joint origin snap to points on that object.
label.translation: Place the pointer over over a face or edge and press Ctrl (Windows) or Command (Mac) to lock the joint origin snap to points on that object.

label.devLabel: An As-Built Joint maintains the positions of components, and defines relative motions between them. You can use them when components don't need to be moved and you only need to define the motion.
label.translation: An As-Built Joint maintains the positions of components, and defines relative motions between them. You can use them when components don't need to be moved and you only need to define the motion.

label.devLabel: Select a face or edge to limit selections to only points on that face or edge. Right-click and select Between to create a joint centered between two faces; select two faces from the same component then select a point.
label.translation: Select a face or edge to limit selections to only points on that face or edge. Right-click and select Between to create a joint centered between two faces; select two faces from the same component then select a point.

label.devLabel: Hover over a face or edge and press Ctrl (Windows) or Command (Mac) to lock the joint origin snap to points on that object.
label.translation: Hover over a face or edge and press Ctrl (Windows) or Command (Mac) to lock the joint origin snap to points on that object.

label.devLabel: Position components relative to each other in an assembly, then defines the relative motion between them.
label.translation: Position components relative to each other in an assembly, then defines the relative motion between them.

label.devLabel: On the Position tab, place a joint origin snap point on each component to position them. On the Motion tab, select the motion Type, then adjust associated settings, add joint limits, and preview joint motion.
label.translation: On the Position tab, place a joint origin snap point on each component to position them. On the Motion tab, select the motion Type, then adjust associated settings, add joint limits, and preview joint motion.

label.devLabel: Positions a joint origin on a component. Joint origins define the geometry used to relate a joint's components.
label.translation: Positions a joint origin on a component. Joint origins define the geometry used to relate a joint's components.

label.devLabel: Select geometry to define the joint origin.
label.translation: Select geometry to define the joint origin.

label.devLabel:
Select Joint Origin mode, select geometry, and snap the Joint Origin into position.
Adjust Alignment settings like Angle, Offset, and Flip to set the orientation of the Joint Origin.
label.translation:
Select Joint Origin mode, select geometry, and snap the Joint Origin into position.
Adjust Alignment settings like Angle, Offset, and Flip to set the orientation of the Joint Origin.

label.devLabel:
Choose from 3 Joint Origin modes.
Simple: create a Joint Origin on a face or edge.
Between Two Faces: center a Joint Origin between two faces.
Two Edge Intersection: create a Joint Origin at the apparent intersection of two edges.
Use Joint Origin with Joint to define motion between components.
label.translation:
Выберите один из 3 режимов происхождения шарнира.
Простой: создать происхождение шарнира на грани или ребре.
Между двумя гранями: разместить происхождение шарнира между двумя гранями.
Пересечение двух рёбер: создать происхождение шарнира в точке видимого пересечения двух рёбер.
Используйте происхождение шарнира вместе со Шарниром для определения движения между компонентами.

label.devLabel: Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) general note.
label.translation: Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) general note.

label.devLabel: Add a leader line and include general information, such as instructions, references to standards, or clarifications.
label.translation: Add a leader line and include general information, such as instructions, references to standards, or clarifications.

label.devLabel: Use of this feature will connect you to an external website. By enabling this workflow, Autodesk does not guarantee, approve or endorse the information or products available at these sites, nor does a link or this feature indicate any association with or endorsement by the linked site to Autodesk or %1%.
label.translation: Использование этой функции подключит вас к внешнему веб-сайту. Включение этого рабочего процесса не означает, что Autodesk гарантирует, одобряет или рекомендует информацию или продукты, доступные на этих сайтах, и ссылка или эта функция не указывает на какое-либо сотрудничество или одобрение со стороны связанного сайта в отношении Autodesk или %1%.

label.devLabel: After you place the text frame, use the rotation manipulator handle to rotate it. Click any snap point on the text frame to change the point around which you rotate the text frame.
label.translation: After you place the text frame, use the rotation manipulator handle to rotate it. Click any snap point on the text frame to change the point around which you rotate the text frame.

label.devLabel: Opens the Material Browser, where you can manage physical materials and appearances in user-defined material libraries.
label.translation: Opens the Material Browser, where you can manage physical materials and appearances in user-defined material libraries.

label.devLabel: Navigate between libraries, create new libraries, and add physical materials or appearances to your Favorites. In custom libraries, edit the properties of physical materials and appearances, or create new ones.
label.translation: Navigate between libraries, create new libraries, and add physical materials or appearances to your Favorites. In custom libraries, edit the properties of physical materials and appearances, or create new ones.

label.devLabel: Opens the bill of materials for this design.
label.translation: Opens the bill of materials for this design.

label.devLabel: (May not be available in some situations, such as when viewing a configured design, or when Fusion is offline.)
label.translation: (May not be available in some situations, such as when viewing a configured design, or when Fusion is offline.)

label.devLabel: An error occurred during download. Refresh the page and try again.
label.translation: An error occurred during download. Refresh the page and try again.

label.devLabel: Measures the distance, angle, area, or position of selected objects.
label.translation: Measures the distance, angle, area, or position of selected objects.

label.devLabel: Select an object to measure it, and optionally select a second object to measure it and the distance between them.
label.translation: Select an object to measure it, and optionally select a second object to measure it and the distance between them.

label.devLabel: Click a value in the dialog to copy the value to the clipboard.
label.translation: Click a value in the dialog to copy the value to the clipboard.

label.devLabel: Select the geometry to measure. The results reported are determined by the type of geometry selected. The measurement is the minimum distance between the two selections.
label.translation: Select the geometry to measure. The results reported are determined by the type of geometry selected. The measurement is the minimum distance between the two selections.

label.devLabel: Creates a line that is symmetrical from the midpoint.
label.translation: Creates a line that is symmetrical from the midpoint.

label.devLabel: Specify the midpoint to start a line, and click to set the end of the line.
label.translation: Specify the midpoint to start a line, and click to set the end of the line.

label.devLabel: Regions with a higher curvature than the minimum radius will be highlighted in red.
label.translation: Regions with a higher curvature than the minimum radius will be highlighted in red.

label.devLabel: Select the bodies to evaluate. Use the options to refine the minimum radius.
label.translation: Select the bodies to evaluate. Use the options to refine the minimum radius.

label.devLabel: Creates a copy of selected faces, bodies, features, or components, mirrored across a plane.
label.translation: Creates a copy of selected faces, bodies, features, or components, mirrored across a plane.

label.devLabel: Select the objects to mirror, then select the mirror plane.
label.translation: Select the objects to mirror, then select the mirror plane.

label.devLabel: Mirrors the selected sketch curves about a selected sketch line.
label.translation: Mirrors the selected sketch curves about a selected sketch line.

label.devLabel: Select the curves to mirror then select the line to mirror about.
label.translation: Select the curves to mirror then select the line to mirror about.

label.devLabel: The mirror command also also adds a mirror symmetry constraint to the geometry.
label.translation: The mirror command also also adds a mirror symmetry constraint to the geometry.

label.devLabel: Select the sketch curves to mirror then select the line to mirror around. The mirror line must be a line in the active sketch.
label.translation: Select the sketch curves to mirror then select the line to mirror around. The mirror line must be a line in the active sketch.

label.devLabel: When you mirror solid or surface bodies, select the Join operation to combine or stitch the mirrored bodies together where they intersect.
label.translation: When you mirror solid or surface bodies, select the Join operation to combine or stitch the mirrored bodies together where they intersect.

label.devLabel: When you mirror features, select the Compute Option that works best for your design. Compute options can affect performance based on the complexity of the features you are mirroring.
label.translation: When you mirror features, select the Compute Option that works best for your design. Compute options can affect performance based on the complexity of the features you are mirroring.

label.devLabel: Creates mechanical designs that contain mostly prismatic geometry. Access commands to create solid bodies.
label.translation: Creates mechanical designs that contain mostly prismatic geometry. Access commands to create solid bodies.

label.devLabel: Scales sketch objects, bodies, or components.
label.translation: Scales sketch objects, bodies, or components.

label.devLabel: Select the objects to scale then specify the scale factor.
label.translation: Select the objects to scale then specify the scale factor.

label.devLabel: Change the Scale Type to Non Uniform to input different scale factors in the X, Y, and Z directions.
label.translation: Change the Scale Type to Non Uniform to input different scale factors in the X, Y, and Z directions.

label.devLabel: Select the objects to scale and the point from which to scale, then specify the scale factor.
label.translation: Select the objects to scale and the point from which to scale, then specify the scale factor.

label.devLabel: Defines rotational and translational relationship between joint degrees of freedom.
label.translation: Defines rotational and translational relationship between joint degrees of freedom.

label.devLabel: Select the joints then specify the values.
label.translation: Select the joints then specify the values.

label.devLabel: Select two joints then specify their relative motion.
label.translation: Select two joints then specify their relative motion.

label.devLabel: Performs kinematic motion analysis based on joints.
label.translation: Performs kinematic motion analysis based on joints.

label.devLabel: Select the joints to participate then specify points and values for the motion.
label.translation: Select the joints to participate then specify points and values for the motion.

label.devLabel: Moves the selected face, body, sketch, or construction geometry a specified distance or angle.
label.translation: Moves the selected face, body, sketch, or construction geometry a specified distance or angle.

label.devLabel: Select the objects to modify then specify the distance or angle. Use Set Pivot to reposition the manipulator.
label.translation: Select the objects to modify then specify the distance or angle. Use Set Pivot to reposition the manipulator.

label.devLabel: Specify the rotation angle or distance value for joint degrees of freedom.
label.translation: Specify the rotation angle or distance value for joint degrees of freedom.

label.devLabel: Select a joint, then used the manipulators or the dialog to modify joint values.
label.translation: Select a joint, then used the manipulators or the dialog to modify joint values.

label.devLabel: Inserts the active design into an Assembly Design as an external component.
label.translation: Inserts the active design into an Assembly Design as an external component.

label.devLabel: Select an Assembly Design to insert into, then use the manipulators in the canvas or Initial Position dialog to place the component in the target design.
label.translation: Select an Assembly Design to insert into, then use the manipulators in the canvas or Initial Position dialog to place the component in the target design.

label.devLabel: Creates a new internal or external component in the assembly.
label.translation: Creates a new internal or external component in the assembly.

label.devLabel: Select type and parent, then name the component. For external components, select location. For internal components, you can select bodies to create a component for each.
label.translation: Select type and parent, then name the component. For external components, select location. For internal components, you can select bodies to create a component for each.

label.devLabel: Copies the selected sketch curves a specified distance from the original curves.
label.translation: Copies the selected sketch curves a specified distance from the original curves.

label.devLabel: Select the curves to offset then specify the offset distance.
label.translation: Select the curves to offset then specify the offset distance.

label.devLabel: EDIT : Copies the selected sketch curves a specified distance from the original curves.
label.translation: EDIT : Copies the selected sketch curves a specified distance from the original curves.

label.devLabel: EDIT : Select the curves to offset then specify the offset distance.
label.translation: EDIT : Select the curves to offset then specify the offset distance.

label.devLabel: EDIT : The size and position of the new geometry is associated to the original geometry. To remove this association, select the offset glyph in the canvas then right-click and select Delete.
label.translation: EDIT : The size and position of the new geometry is associated to the original geometry. To remove this association, select the offset glyph in the canvas then right-click and select Delete.

label.devLabel: EDIT : Select the curves to offset then enter an offset distance or drag the manipulator.
label.translation: EDIT : Select the curves to offset then enter an offset distance or drag the manipulator.

label.devLabel: Shifts the selected face or faces in a positive or negative direction.
label.translation: Shifts the selected face or faces in a positive or negative direction.

label.devLabel: Select a single face or multiple faces and specify the Offset distance.
label.translation: Select a single face or multiple faces and specify the Offset distance.

label.devLabel: Adjoining curved tangent Faces will Offset when geometrically possible.
label.translation: Adjoining curved tangent Faces will Offset when geometrically possible.

label.devLabel: Select a single face or multiple faces and specify the Offset distance.
label.translation: Select a single face or multiple faces and specify the Offset distance.

label.devLabel: The size and position of the new geometry is associated to the original geometry. To remove this association, select the offset glyph in the canvas then right-click and select Delete.
label.translation: The size and position of the new geometry is associated to the original geometry. To remove this association, select the offset glyph in the canvas then right-click and select Delete.

label.devLabel: Select the curves to offset then enter an offset distance or drag the manipulator.
label.translation: Select the curves to offset then enter an offset distance or drag the manipulator.

label.devLabel: The selected DXF file does not contain any supported 2D geometry. Insert DXF only inserts 2D geometry. To import a DXF with 3D geometry, use Upload in the Data Panel.
label.translation: The selected DXF file does not contain any supported 2D geometry. Insert DXF only inserts 2D geometry. To import a DXF with 3D geometry, use Upload in the Data Panel.

label.devLabel: Opens the list of members in Part Number Group .
label.translation: Opens the list of members in Part Number Group .

label.devLabel: Silhouette Split works best with shelled bodies.
label.translation: Silhouette Split works best with shelled bodies.

label.devLabel: Set the view direction by selecting a plane or axis then select the body and choose a split operation.
label.translation: Set the view direction by selecting a plane or axis then select the body and choose a split operation.

label.devLabel: Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them around a linear axis to create a circular pattern.
label.translation: Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them around a linear axis to create a circular pattern.

label.devLabel: Select the object type, then select objects to pattern in the canvas, Browser, or Timeline. Select the axis to distribute the pattern instances around, then adjust distribution, quantity, and distance. Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.
label.translation: Select the object type, then select objects to pattern in the canvas, Browser, or Timeline. Select the axis to distribute the pattern instances around, then adjust distribution, quantity, and distance. Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.

label.devLabel: Set Distribution to Full to distribute pattern instances 360 degrees around the axis. Set Distribution to Angle to distribute pattern instances in one direction from the source object around the axis to an angle value that you specify. Set Distribution to Symmetric to distribute pattern instances symmetrically in two directions from the source object around the axis to an angle value that you specify.
label.translation: Установите параметр "Распределение" на "Полный" для распределения экземпляров узора на 360 градусов вокруг оси. Установите параметр "Распределение" на "Угол" для распределения экземпляров узора в одном направлении от исходного объекта вокруг оси на заданный вами угол. Установите параметр "Распределение" на "Симметрично" для симметричного распределения экземпляров узора в двух направлениях от исходного объекта вокруг оси на заданный вами угол.

label.devLabel: Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.
label.translation: Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.

label.devLabel: Creates a pattern with size and distribution gradients across a face on a solid body.
label.translation: Creates a pattern with size and distribution gradients across a face on a solid body.

label.devLabel: Select the face to pattern across, select a solid body as the object to pattern, then adjust the size and distribution settings.
label.translation: Select the face to pattern across, select a solid body as the object to pattern, then adjust the size and distribution settings.

label.devLabel: Adjust the Operation to Cut material away from the existing body, Join material to it, Intersect the bodies to keep on the material that overlaps, or create New Bodies in the design.
label.translation: Adjust the Operation to Cut material away from the existing body, Join material to it, Intersect the bodies to keep on the material that overlaps, or create New Bodies in the design.

label.devLabel: Adjust the size limits and spread to control the gradient across the pattern.
label.translation: Adjust the size limits and spread to control the gradient across the pattern.

label.devLabel: Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them to create a pattern along a specific path.
label.translation: Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them to create a pattern along a specific path.

label.devLabel: Select the object type, then select objects to pattern in the canvas, Browser, or Timeline. Select the path to distribute the pattern instances along, then adjust distribution, quantity, and distance. Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.
label.translation: Выберите тип объекта, затем выберите объекты для создания копий на холсте, в браузере или на временной шкале. Выберите путь для распределения копий, затем настройте распределение, количество и расстояние. Установите флажок "Подавление", затем снимите флажки с копий на холсте, чтобы удалить их из копий.

label.devLabel: Set Distribution to Extent to specify the total distance to distribute the pattern along the path. Set Distribution to Spacing to specify the distance between each pattern instance along the path.
label.translation: Set Distribution to Extent to specify the total distance to distribute the pattern along the path. Set Distribution to Spacing to specify the distance between each pattern instance along the path.

label.devLabel: Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.
label.translation: Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.

label.devLabel: Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them along linear axes in rows and columns to create a rectangular pattern.
label.translation: Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them along linear axes in rows and columns to create a rectangular pattern.

label.devLabel: Select the object type, then select objects to pattern in the canvas, Browser, or Timeline. Select one or more axes to distribute the pattern instances along, then adjust distribution, quantity, and distance. Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.
label.translation: Выберите тип объекта, затем выберите объекты для создания массива на холсте, в браузере или на временной шкале. Выберите одну или несколько осей для распределения экземпляров массива, затем настройте распределение, количество и расстояние. Установите флажок "Подавление", затем снимите флажки у экземпляров на холсте, чтобы удалить их из массива.

label.devLabel: Set Distribution to Extent to specify the total distance to distribute the pattern along each axis. Set Distribution to Spacing to specify the distance between each pattern instance along each axis.
label.translation: Set Distribution to Extent to specify the total distance to distribute the pattern along each axis. Set Distribution to Spacing to specify the distance between each pattern instance along each axis.

label.devLabel: Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.
label.translation: Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.

label.devLabel: Assigns physical materials to components and bodies in a design to control their thermal, mechanical, strength, and advanced engineering properties, as well as their appearance.
label.translation: Assigns physical materials to components and bodies in a design to control their thermal, mechanical, strength, and advanced engineering properties, as well as their appearance.

label.devLabel: Drag physical materials onto components or bodies in the canvas or the Browser. In the In This Design section, right-click physical materials to edit, duplicate, delete, or add them as favorites.
label.translation: Drag physical materials onto components or bodies in the canvas or the Browser. In the In This Design section, right-click physical materials to edit, duplicate, delete, or add them as favorites.

label.devLabel: Right-click the material swatch in the In This Design section to edit, duplicate, and access other options.
label.translation: Right-click the material swatch in the In This Design section to edit, duplicate, and access other options.

label.devLabel: Drag the physical material from the dialog to the body or component.
label.translation: Drag the physical material from the dialog to the body or component.

label.devLabel: Downloadable material feature will be re-enabled
label.translation: Downloadable material feature will be re-enabled

label.devLabel: after Fusion finishes the live update and restarts...
label.translation: after Fusion finishes the live update and restarts...

label.devLabel: In a parametric design, use the Offset Type options to modify existing features or to create new features.
label.translation: In a parametric design, use the Offset Type options to modify existing features or to create new features.

label.devLabel: Select a face, edge or profile to modify. Press Pull can be used to offset a face, fillet an edge or extrude a sketch profile.
label.translation: Select a face, edge or profile to modify. Press Pull can be used to offset a face, fillet an edge or extrude a sketch profile.

label.devLabel: Select a plane, draw a rectangle then specify the height of the box.
label.translation: Select a plane, draw a rectangle then specify the height of the box.

label.devLabel: Select a plane then draw a circle to specify the major diameter of the coil. Finish defining the coil using the manipulators or dialog box.
label.translation: Select a plane then draw a circle to specify the major diameter of the coil. Finish defining the coil using the manipulators or dialog box.

label.devLabel: Select a plane, draw a circle then specify the height of the cylinder.
label.translation: Select a plane, draw a circle then specify the height of the cylinder.

label.devLabel: Creates a solid pipe that follows a selected path.
label.translation: Creates a solid pipe that follows a selected path.

label.devLabel: Select the path then specify the section and size.
label.translation: Select the path then specify the section and size.

label.devLabel: Select a plane then specify the center point of the sphere and the diameter.
label.translation: Select a plane then specify the center point of the sphere and the diameter.

label.devLabel: Specify the center point and diameter of the axis of revolution of the torus.
label.translation: Specify the center point and diameter of the axis of revolution of the torus.

label.devLabel: Projects the body silhouette, edges, work geometries and sketch curves into the active sketch plane.
label.translation: Projects the body silhouette, edges, work geometries and sketch curves into the active sketch plane.

label.devLabel: Use the selection filter to project specific type of geometry or the body silhouette.
label.translation: Use the selection filter to project specific type of geometry or the body silhouette.

label.devLabel: In the selection filter Specified Entities will project points, lines, arcs, etc. Bodies will project the entire silhoutte of the object selected.
label.translation: In the selection filter Specified Entities will project points, lines, arcs, etc. Bodies will project the entire silhoutte of the object selected.

label.devLabel: Set the selection filter then select the objects to project into the sketch.
label.translation: Set the selection filter then select the objects to project into the sketch.

label.devLabel: Project sketch geometry, edge, vertex, or workpoint to selected faces.
label.translation: Project sketch geometry, edge, vertex, or workpoint to selected faces.

label.devLabel: Start a new sketch to contain the projected geometry.
label.translation: Start a new sketch to contain the projected geometry.

label.devLabel: Select the face to project on to then select the sketch curves to project.
label.translation: Select the face to project on to then select the sketch curves to project.

label.devLabel: Before you start Insert Derive, activate the component that you want to contain the derived design features. Select objects in the canvas or browser to add to the list of derived objects. When you select a component, all objects in the component are included. Click the X button in the dialog to remove selected objects from the list.
label.translation: Перед началом использования команды "Вставить производный", активируйте компонент, в котором должны содержаться производные элементы конструкции. Выберите объекты на холсте или в браузере, чтобы добавить их в список производных объектов. При выборе компонента включаются все объекты в этом компоненте. Нажмите кнопку X в диалоговом окне, чтобы удалить выбранные объекты из списка.

label.devLabel: Use Derive to maintain common parameters in a single design and reuse them in multiple other designs design.
label.translation: Use Derive to maintain common parameters in a single design and reuse them in multiple other designs design.

label.devLabel: Before you start Insert Derive, activate the component that you want to contain the derived design features. Select objects in the canvas or browser to add to the list of derived objects. When you select a component, all objects in the component are included. Click the X button in the dialog to remove selected objects from the list.
label.translation: Перед началом использования команды "Вставить производный", активируйте компонент, в котором должны содержаться производные элементы конструкции. Выберите объекты на холсте или в браузере, чтобы добавить их в список производных объектов. При выборе компонента включаются все объекты в этом компоненте. Нажмите кнопку X в диалоговом окне, чтобы удалить выбранные объекты из списка.

label.devLabel: Use Derive to maintain common parameters in a single design and reuse them in multiple other designs design.
label.translation: Use Derive to maintain common parameters in a single design and reuse them in multiple other designs design.

label.devLabel: Transitions the component to the next life cycle state or revision without a change order.
label.translation: Transitions the component to the next life cycle state or revision without a change order.

label.devLabel: The final release still requires a change order. This only works on the top level component or external references - not internal components.
label.translation: The final release still requires a change order. This only works on the top level component or external references - not internal components.

label.devLabel: Duplicates sketch curves in rows and columns.
label.translation: Duplicates sketch curves in rows and columns.

label.devLabel: Select the curves to pattern then specify the direction, quantity, and distance.
label.translation: Select the curves to pattern then specify the direction, quantity, and distance.

label.devLabel:
A pattern glyph is placed at the center of the pattern. Double-click the glyph to edit the pattern.

Set Distance Type to Extent to specify the total distance of the pattern. Set the Distance Type to Spacing to specify the distance between objects.
label.translation:
Символ шаблона размещается в центре шаблона. Дважды щелкните по символу, чтобы изменить шаблон.

Установите тип расстояния "Расстояние", чтобы указать общее расстояние шаблона. Установите тип расстояния "Шаг", чтобы указать расстояние между объектами.

label.devLabel: Select the curves to pattern then select the directions if they are not horizontal and vertical.
label.translation: Select the curves to pattern then select the directions if they are not horizontal and vertical.

label.devLabel: Use the Reference Objects command to explicitly reference objects in an assembly before starting detailed design work.
label.translation: Use the Reference Objects command to explicitly reference objects in an assembly before starting detailed design work.

label.devLabel: To make detailed design work clearer and easier to perform, reference only the objects in the assembly that are important for a component in context.
label.translation: To make detailed design work clearer and easier to perform, reference only the objects in the assembly that are important for a component in context.

label.devLabel: Delete constraints and dimensions, then Refresh to generate new ones.
label.translation: Удалите ограничения и размеры, затем Обновить, чтобы сгенерировать новые.

label.devLabel: Generates new constraints and dimensions to replace deleted ones.
label.translation: Generates new constraints and dimensions to replace deleted ones.

label.devLabel: Deletes selected components or bodies from the design and preserves the operation as a feature in the timeline. Removed objects can be restored parametrically.
label.translation: Deletes selected components or bodies from the design and preserves the operation as a feature in the timeline. Removed objects can be restored parametrically.

label.devLabel: Select components or bodies to remove. To permanently delete parametric history associated with an object, use the Delete command instead.
label.translation: Select components or bodies to remove. To permanently delete parametric history associated with an object, use the Delete command instead.

label.devLabel: If the desired effect is not achieved undo and select additional surfaces or less surfaces and try the command or try manual selection and the delete key.
label.translation: If the desired effect is not achieved undo and select additional surfaces or less surfaces and try the command or try manual selection and the delete key.

label.devLabel: This will delete a group of faces and use the surrounding faces to maintain a valid 3D body.
label.translation: This will delete a group of faces and use the surrounding faces to maintain a valid 3D body.

label.devLabel: Set the tolerance and look at the highlighted features that will be removed. If a valid body can't be obtained after removal try adjusting the tolerance with the slider.
label.translation: Set the tolerance and look at the highlighted features that will be removed. If a valid body can't be obtained after removal try adjusting the tolerance with the slider.

label.devLabel: This tool allows the fast removal of simple features like chamfers, and small holes.
label.translation: This tool allows the fast removal of simple features like chamfers, and small holes.

label.devLabel: Generates realistic renderings of the design.
label.translation: Generates realistic renderings of the design.

label.devLabel: Set the environment and lighting for the scene. This setting only affects the Rendering workspace.
label.translation: Set the environment and lighting for the scene. This setting only affects the Rendering workspace.

label.devLabel: Open the Environment Library tab to apply a pre-configured lighting setup, download new environments from the cloud, or attach a custom HDR environment. Brightness adjusts the lighting intensity, and Rotation adjusts the location of lights and shadows.
label.translation: Откройте вкладку "Библиотека окружения", чтобы применить предварительно настроенную схему освещения, скачать новые окружения из облака или присоединить пользовательское HDR-окружение. Яркость регулирует интенсивность освещения, а Вращение — расположение источников света и теней.

label.devLabel: Set the environment and lighting for the scene. This settings only affects the Rendering workspace.
label.translation: Set the environment and lighting for the scene. This settings only affects the Rendering workspace.

label.devLabel: Replaces one or more part faces with different face. The new face must completely intersect the part.
label.translation: Replaces one or more part faces with different face. The new face must completely intersect the part.

label.devLabel: Select the face to remove then select the new face.
label.translation: Select the face to remove then select the new face.

label.devLabel: The target faces must completely enclose the source faces.
label.translation: The target faces must completely enclose the source faces.

label.devLabel: Select the faces to remove (Source Faces) then select the new faces (Target Faces).
label.translation: Select the faces to remove (Source Faces) then select the new faces (Target Faces).

label.devLabel: Select an object or group of objects to replace. Select the desired simple shape to replace the object or objects. The default shape will bound all of the selected objects and the original objects are suppressed.
label.translation: Select an object or group of objects to replace. Select the desired simple shape to replace the object or objects. The default shape will bound all of the selected objects and the original objects are suppressed.

label.devLabel: Replaces selected objects with primitive shapes (Box, Cylinder, Sphere).
label.translation: Replaces selected objects with primitive shapes (Box, Cylinder, Sphere).

label.devLabel: Select missing xRefs from browser tree or from timeline to resolve.
label.translation: Select missing xRefs from browser tree or from timeline to resolve.

label.devLabel: Revolves a sketch profile or planar face around a selected axis.
label.translation: Revolves a sketch profile or planar face around a selected axis.

label.devLabel: Select a profile or planar face and an axis to revolve around, then specify the extent type, direction, and operation.
label.translation: Select a profile or planar face and an axis to revolve around, then specify the extent type, direction, and operation.

label.devLabel: If you have a profile and a single center line selected then create a Revolve feature, the dialog will detect those selections and auto-select the Profile and Axis options.
label.translation: If you have a profile and a single center line selected then create a Revolve feature, the dialog will detect those selections and auto-select the Profile and Axis options.

label.devLabel: Locks the relative position of the selected components. The components are treated as a single object when moved or when joints are applied.
label.translation: Locks the relative position of the selected components. The components are treated as a single object when moved or when joints are applied.

label.devLabel: Select the components to group together.
label.translation: Select the components to group together.

label.devLabel: Add Joints between components in different Rigid Groups to define motion between subassemblies, and the entire group moves together.
label.translation: Add Joints between components in different Rigid Groups to define motion between subassemblies, and the entire group moves together.

label.devLabel: Use Rigid Group for three or more components to form a subassembly instead of creating a rigid joint between each pair. This helps reduce the number of features to compute in the Timeline.
label.translation: Use Rigid Group for three or more components to form a subassembly instead of creating a rigid joint between each pair. This helps reduce the number of features to compute in the Timeline.

label.devLabel: Saves main assembly and all opened and migrated external reference (xRef) files and updates their references to point to new versions.
label.translation: Saves main assembly and all opened and migrated external reference (xRef) files and updates their references to point to new versions.

label.devLabel: The command uses a two-phase approach: first saves all xRef assets to create new versions, then updates all references in the assembly to point to the new versions. This ensures consistency between saved versions and references.
label.translation: Команда использует двухэтапный подход: сначала сохраняет все внешние ссылки (xRef) для создания новых версий, затем обновляет все ссылки в сборке, чтобы они указывали на новые версии. Это обеспечивает согласованность между сохраненными версиями и ссылками.

label.devLabel: The command automatically finds all migrated xRef assets, marks them as dirty to generate new revision GUIDs, saves each xRef asset to create new versions on disk, then updates all assembly references to point to the new versions.
label.translation: Команда автоматически находит все перенесенные активы xRef, помечает их как измененные для создания новых GUID редакций, сохраняет каждый актив xRef для создания новых версий на диске, а затем обновляет все ссылки в сборках для указания на новые версии.

label.devLabel: This command is similar to what End EIP Command does for xRef handling. Use it after opening a document that contains migrated external references to save the migrated state and update all references.
label.translation: This command is similar to what End EIP Command does for xRef handling. Use it after opening a document that contains migrated external references to save the migrated state and update all references.

label.devLabel: Consider all possible paths between the boundary objects and the seed object. For example, if there are holes between the inside and outside of the body, then both internal and external faces will be included in the selection set unless you include the edges or faces of the holes as boundary objects.
label.translation: Consider all possible paths between the boundary objects and the seed object. For example, if there are holes between the inside and outside of the body, then both internal and external faces will be included in the selection set unless you include the edges or faces of the holes as boundary objects.

label.devLabel: Select one or more faces or edges on a solid or surface body to define the boundary of the area where you want to create your selection set.
label.translation: Select one or more faces or edges on a solid or surface body to define the boundary of the area where you want to create your selection set.

label.devLabel: Adds to the PMI note all holes or bosses that match the first selected feature, including its defining properties such as size and color.
label.translation: Добавляет к примечанию PMI все отверстия или выступы, совпадающие с первым выбранным элементом, включая его определяющие свойства, такие как размер и цвет.

label.devLabel: Switches the selection state of all objects.
label.translation: Switches the selection state of all objects.

label.devLabel: Selection is based on the active selection filter and selection mode.
label.translation: Selection is based on the active selection filter and selection mode.

label.devLabel:
Selects objects enclosed in an irregular (lasso) selection area.
A clockwise boundary shape selects all objects within the boundary. A counterclockwise boundary shape selects all visible objects crossed by the boundary.
Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.
Hold Shift (â§): Add faces to your selection. Faces already selected will stay selected when overlapped. Hold Ctrl (â for Mac): Deselect faces from your selection. Faces not already selected will stay unselected when overlapped.
label.translation:
Выбирает объекты, заключенные в нерегулярную область выделения (по типу лассо).
По часовой стрелке граница области выбирает все объекты внутри границы. Против часовой стрелки граница области выбирает все видимые объекты, пересекаемые границей.
Используйте фильтры выделения для включения или исключения объектов по типу.
Удерживайте Shift (â§): Добавляйте грани в выделение. Уже выбранные грани останутся выделенными при наложении. Удерживайте Ctrl (â для Mac): Снимайте выделение с граней. Не выбранные грани останутся невыделенными при наложении.

label.devLabel:
Press and hold the left mouse button and move across objects to select them.
Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.
Hold Shift (â§): Add faces to your selection. Faces already selected will stay selected when overlapped. Hold Ctrl (â for Mac): Deselect faces from your selection. Faces not already selected will stay unselected when overlapped.
label.translation:
Удерживая левую кнопку мыши, перемещайте ее по объектам для их выбора.
Используйте Фильтры выделения, чтобы включать или исключать объекты по типу.
Удерживайте Shift (â§): Добавляйте грани в выделение. Уже выделенные грани останутся выделенными при наложении. Удерживайте Ctrl (â для Mac): Снимайте выделение с граней. Не выделенные грани останутся невыделенными при наложении.

label.devLabel:
Selects objects enclosed in a rectangular selection area.
Click and drag from upper-left to lower-right (window selection) to select objects enclosed by the selection boundary. Click and drag from lower-right to upper-left (crossing selection) to select all visible objects the selection boundary intersects and encloses.
Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.
Hold Shift (â§): Add faces to your selection. Faces already selected will stay selected when overlapped. Hold Ctrl (â for Mac): Deselect faces from your selection. Faces not already selected will stay unselected when overlapped.
label.translation:
Выбирает объекты, заключенные в прямоугольной области выделения.
Щелкните и перетащите от верхнего левого угла к нижнему правому (выделение окном), чтобы выбрать объекты, заключенные в пределах границы выделения. Щелкните и перетащите от нижнего правого угла к верхнему левому (выделение с пересечением), чтобы выбрать все видимые объекты, которые пересекает и заключает граница выделения.
Используйте фильтры выделения, чтобы включать или исключать объекты по типу.
Удерживайте Shift (â§): Добавьте грани к выделению. Грани, уже выделенные, останутся выделенными при наложении. Удерживайте Ctrl (â для Mac): Снимите выделение с граней. Грани, не выделенные ранее, останутся невыделенными при наложении.

label.devLabel: Lets you select a new datum to relign the added dimensions.
label.translation: Позволяет выбрать новую плоскость для выравнивания добавленных размеров.

label.devLabel: Creates an arc slot defined by a center point, two point center arc and slot width.
label.translation: Creates an arc slot defined by a center point, two point center arc and slot width.

label.devLabel: Specify the center point of the slot. Specify the start and end point of the slot center arc. Click to specify slot width or enter diameter or radius of the slot arc.
label.translation: Specify the center point of the slot. Specify the start and end point of the slot center arc. Click to specify slot width or enter diameter or radius of the slot arc.

label.devLabel: Creates an arc slot defined by a three point center arc and slot width.
label.translation: Creates an arc slot defined by a three point center arc and slot width.

label.devLabel: Specify the start and end point of the slot center arc. Specify the third point of the center arc, or enter center arc radius. Click to specify slot width, or enter diameter or radius of the slot arcs.
label.translation: Specify the start and end point of the slot center arc. Specify the third point of the center arc, or enter center arc radius. Click to specify slot width, or enter diameter or radius of the slot arcs.

label.devLabel: Creates a polygon using the center point and the midpoint of one edge.
label.translation: Creates a polygon using the center point and the midpoint of one edge.

label.devLabel: Select the center point of the polygon. Specify a value for the number of sides. Select the midpoint of an edge or specify a distance and select a point.
label.translation: Select the center point of the polygon. Specify a value for the number of sides. Select the midpoint of an edge or specify a distance and select a point.

label.devLabel: Creates a polygon by defining a single edge and the position of the polygon.
label.translation: Creates a polygon by defining a single edge and the position of the polygon.

label.devLabel: Select the start and end points of one edge or select the start point then specify a distance and angle. Specify the number of sides. Select a point to define the orientation of the polygon.
label.translation: Select the start and end points of one edge or select the start point then specify a distance and angle. Specify the number of sides. Select a point to define the orientation of the polygon.

label.devLabel: Creates a polygon using the center point and a vertex.
label.translation: Creates a polygon using the center point and a vertex.

label.devLabel: Select the center point of the polygon. Specify a value for the number of edges. Select a vertex point or specify a distance and select a point.
label.translation: Select the center point of the polygon. Specify a value for the number of edges. Select a vertex point or specify a distance and select a point.

label.devLabel: Creates a rectangle using two points to define the center and one corner.
label.translation: Creates a rectangle using two points to define the center and one corner.

label.devLabel: Select the first point as the center of the rectangle. Select a corner point or specify width and height values.
label.translation: Select the first point as the center of the rectangle. Select a corner point or specify width and height values.

label.devLabel: Creates a rectangle using three points to define width, direction, and height.
label.translation: Creates a rectangle using three points to define width, direction, and height.

label.devLabel: Select the first point as the start of the rectangle. Select a second point or specify a distance value and pick a point. Select a third point or specify a distance value.
label.translation: Select the first point as the start of the rectangle. Select a second point or specify a distance value and pick a point. Select a third point or specify a distance value.

label.devLabel: Creates a rectangle using two points for the diagonal corners.
label.translation: Creates a rectangle using two points for the diagonal corners.

label.devLabel: Select the first point as the start of the rectangle. Select the second point or specify the width and height values.
label.translation: Select the first point as the start of the rectangle. Select the second point or specify the width and height values.

label.devLabel: Creates a linear slot defined by a center point, location of slot arc centers, and by slot width.
label.translation: Creates a linear slot defined by a center point, location of slot arc centers, and by slot width.

label.devLabel: Specify the slot center, and place center of a slot arc. Click to specify slot width, or enter diameter of the slot arcs.
label.translation: Specify the slot center, and place center of a slot arc. Click to specify slot width, or enter diameter of the slot arcs.

label.devLabel: Creates a linear slot defined by placement and distance of slot arc centers, and by slot width.
label.translation: Creates a linear slot defined by placement and distance of slot arc centers, and by slot width.

label.devLabel: Specify centers of both slot arcs. Click to specify slot width, or enter diameter of the slot arcs.
label.translation: Specify centers of both slot arcs. Click to specify slot width, or enter diameter of the slot arcs.

label.devLabel: Creates a linear slot defined by orientation, length and width.
label.translation: Creates a linear slot defined by orientation, length and width.

label.devLabel: Specify the start and end on the slot center line. Click to specify slot width, or enter diameter of the slot arcs.
label.translation: Specify the start and end on the slot center line. Click to specify slot width, or enter diameter of the slot arcs.

label.devLabel: Offsets the walls of a solid body to create a hollow cavity with walls of a specified thickness.
label.translation: Offsets the walls of a solid body to create a hollow cavity with walls of a specified thickness.

label.devLabel: Select a body to shell or faces to remove to create an opening, then specify a type, direction, and wall thickness.
label.translation: Select a body to shell or faces to remove to create an opening, then specify a type, direction, and wall thickness.

label.devLabel: Displays the version history of the selected component.
label.translation: Displays the version history of the selected component.

label.devLabel: Select a component to view its version history and optionally choose a different version.
label.translation: Select a component to view its version history and optionally choose a different version.

label.devLabel: Finds components in your hub that are similar to those in the active design.
label.translation: Finds components in your hub that are similar to those in the active design.

label.devLabel: You can select similar components and open them or insert them into your design. This is available for solid bodies only and isn’t supported for mesh or surface bodies, configured designs, or parts from the Fasteners Library.
label.translation: You can select similar components and open them or insert them into your design. This is available for solid bodies only and isn’t supported for mesh or surface bodies, configured designs, or parts from the Fasteners Library.

label.devLabel: Creates a shareable link so that viewers can download the design, view it online, or share it with others.
label.translation: Creates a shareable link so that viewers can download the design, view it online, or share it with others.

label.devLabel: You can protect the link with a password; the design can be viewed in the cloud even without Fusion installed.
label.translation: You can protect the link with a password; the design can be viewed in the cloud even without Fusion installed.

label.devLabel: Select a sketch entity to apply constraints automatically.
label.translation: Select a sketch entity to apply constraints automatically.

label.devLabel: Enters Sketch mode, where you create geometric profiles that define the foundation of a design. Then use commands like Extrude, Revolve, and Loft to create 3D bodies from sketches.
label.translation: Enters Sketch mode, where you create geometric profiles that define the foundation of a design. Then use commands like Extrude, Revolve, and Loft to create 3D bodies from sketches.

label.devLabel: Select a construction plane, then create lines, arcs, or points to create sketch and construction geometry. Constrain sketches with dimensions and constraints. Select Finish Sketch to exit Sketch mode.
label.translation: Select a construction plane, then create lines, arcs, or points to create sketch and construction geometry. Constrain sketches with dimensions and constraints. Select Finish Sketch to exit Sketch mode.

label.devLabel: Create sketch dimensions for sketch geometries. Use dimensions to control the size or position of sketch objects.
label.translation: Create sketch dimensions for sketch geometries. Use dimensions to control the size or position of sketch objects.

label.devLabel: Select the sketch curves to dimension then select an area to position the dimension.
label.translation: Select the sketch curves to dimension then select an area to position the dimension.

label.devLabel:
Export DXF

Exports %1% as a DXF and saves it to your computer or to a project in the cloud.
label.translation:
Export DXF

Exports %1% as a DXF and saves it to your computer or to a project in the cloud.

label.devLabel: Constraints dictate the position of geometry relative to other sketch geometries.
label.translation: Constraints dictate the position of geometry relative to other sketch geometries.

label.devLabel: Imports an SVG file into the active sketch.
label.translation: Imports an SVG file into the active sketch.

label.devLabel: Use SVG files for vector artwork such as logos or custom text.
label.translation: Use SVG files for vector artwork such as logos or custom text.

label.devLabel: Creates smooth curves along a face in the U or V direction.
label.translation: Creates smooth curves along a face in the U or V direction.

label.devLabel: Select to create a single curve or a series of curves, select a face, and specify the curve distribution on the face.
label.translation: Select to create a single curve or a series of curves, select a face, and specify the curve distribution on the face.

label.devLabel: Isoparametric curves follow the surface's internal U or V direction. They reflect the surface's curvature flow and update if the surface changes.
label.translation: Isoparametric curves follow the surface's internal U or V direction. They reflect the surface's curvature flow and update if the surface changes.

label.devLabel: Extract isoparametric curves from a selected face.
label.translation: Extract isoparametric curves from a selected face.

label.devLabel: Moves the selected sketch curve. Curves can be moved off the sketch plane to create a 3D sketch.
label.translation: Moves the selected sketch curve. Curves can be moved off the sketch plane to create a 3D sketch.

label.devLabel: Select the curves to move then specify the new location.
label.translation: Select the curves to move then specify the new location.

label.devLabel: Constrains a closed sketch profile with sides of the same length and equal angles as a regular polygon.
label.translation: Constrains a closed sketch profile with sides of the same length and equal angles as a regular polygon.

label.devLabel: Select sketch geometry to scale, select the point from which to scale, then drag the manipulator handle in the canvas or specify an exact Scale Factor value.
label.translation: Select sketch geometry to scale, select the point from which to scale, then drag the manipulator handle in the canvas or specify an exact Scale Factor value.

label.devLabel: The coil radius is too small!
label.translation: The coil radius is too small!

label.devLabel: Select a plane, draw a rectangle then specify the height of the box. Use the manipulators or the Operation drop down to control the effect the feature has on the design.
label.translation: Select a plane, draw a rectangle then specify the height of the box. Use the manipulators or the Operation drop down to control the effect the feature has on the design.

label.devLabel: Select a plane then draw a circle to specify the major diameter of the coil. Finish defining the coil using the manipulators or dialog box. Use the manipulators or the Operation drop down to control the effect the feature has on the design.
label.translation: Устанавливает направление волокон на оболочке, измеряемое от оси X оболочки против часовой стрелки. Все объекты на оболочке изменяют свою ориентацию, чтобы выровняться с направлением волокон. label.devLabel: Adds depth to open or closed sketch profiles or planar faces.
label.translation: Adds depth to open or closed sketch profiles or planar faces.

label.devLabel: Select the profile or planar face then specify the distance to extrude.
label.translation: Select the profile or planar face then specify the distance to extrude.

label.devLabel: After selecting the profile, you can select faces or points to set the distance value. In parametric modeling, Set Extents to To to maintain an association with selected faces or points.
label.translation: After selecting the profile, you can select faces or points to set the distance value. In parametric modeling, Set Extents to To to maintain an association with selected faces or points.
