label.translation: Select the profile or planar face then specify the distance to extrude. Use the manipulators or the Operation drop down to control the effect the feature has on the design.

label.devLabel: Creates a smooth shape that transitions between two or more sketch profiles or faces.
label.translation: Creates a smooth shape that transitions between two or more sketch profiles or faces.

label.devLabel: Select a series of profiles, planar faces, or non-planar faces to define the shape. Optionally, select rails or centerlines to guide the shape.
label.translation: Select a series of profiles, planar faces, or non-planar faces to define the shape. Optionally, select rails or centerlines to guide the shape.

label.translation: Select a series of profiles, planar faces, or non-planar faces to define a shape. Optionally select rails or a centerline to guide the shape.

label.devLabel: Use the Project Axis option to project the axis to the same plane as the selected profile. Uncheck to return the axis to its original position.
label.translation: Use the Project Axis option to project the axis to the same plane as the selected profile. Uncheck to return the axis to its original position.

label.devLabel: Creates, joins or removes volumes using bounding volumes formed by tool selections.
label.translation: Creates, joins or removes volumes using bounding volumes formed by tool selections.

label.devLabel: Select solids, surfaces or workplanes as tools to form volumes (or cells). These cells can be used to cut existing solids or to join to existing solids or to create a new solid.
label.translation: Select solids, surfaces or workplanes as tools to form volumes (or cells). These cells can be used to cut existing solids or to join to existing solids or to create a new solid.

label.devLabel: Select solids, surfaces or workplanes as tools to form volumes (or cells). These cells can be used to cut existing solids or to join to existing solids or to create a new solid.
label.translation: Select solids, surfaces or workplanes as tools to form volumes (or cells). These cells can be used to cut existing solids or to join to existing solids or to create a new solid.

label.devLabel: Adds thickness to surface faces to create a solid body.
label.translation: Adds thickness to surface faces to create a solid body.

label.devLabel: Select the faces to thicken, then specify a thickness value.
label.translation: Select the faces to thicken, then specify a thickness value.

label.devLabel: Sweeps a sketch profile, planar face, or a solid body along a selected path.
label.translation: Sweeps a sketch profile, planar face, or a solid body along a selected path.

label.devLabel: Select a sweep type, an object and a path to sweep along, then specify the operation. Optionally select rails or a centerline to guide the sweep.
label.translation: Select a sweep type, an object and a path to sweep along, then specify the operation. Optionally select rails or a centerline to guide the sweep.

label.devLabel: For best results, ensure that the path is curvature continuous.
label.translation: For best results, ensure that the path is curvature continuous.

label.devLabel: Select a sketch profile, planar face, or a solid body to sweep along a selected path. Optionally select rails or a centerline to guide the shape.
label.translation: Select a sketch profile, planar face, or a solid body to sweep along a selected path. Optionally select rails or a centerline to guide the shape.

label.devLabel: Enters Form mode and inserts a form feature into the timeline. Use form tools to create and edit history-free bodies by pushing and pulling on vertices, edges, and faces. This is commonly referred to as T-Spline modeling.
label.translation:
В браузере щелкните правой кнопкой мыши компонент листового металла, чтобы настроить его правило листового металла.
Щелкните правой кнопкой мыши тему, чтобы переименовать, дублировать или удалить ее.

label.devLabel: Select Finish Form to exit out of the mode.
label.translation: Select Finish Form to exit out of the mode.

label.devLabel: Creates a transitional shape between two or more sketch profiles or planar faces.
label.translation: Creates a transitional shape between two or more sketch profiles or planar faces.

label.devLabel: Select at least two profiles to define the loft. Refine the shape by using rail or centerline guides or point mapping.
label.translation: Select at least two profiles to define the loft. Refine the shape by using rail or centerline guides or point mapping.

label.devLabel: Changing the continuity from Free to Direction impacts the influence of the corresponding profile across the loft. Set the Spacing setting to Curvature to add faces in areas of higher curvature.
label.translation: Changing the continuity from Free to Direction impacts the influence of the corresponding profile across the loft. Set the Spacing setting to Curvature to add faces in areas of higher curvature.

label.devLabel: Select at least two profiles to define the loft. Refine the shape by using rail or centerline guides or point mapping.
label.translation: Select at least two profiles to define the loft. Refine the shape by using rail or centerline guides or point mapping.

label.devLabel: Select a T-Spline body to save as IGA
label.translation: Select a T-Spline body to save as IGA

label.devLabel: Creates text inside a rectangular frame or along a selected path, which you can use as a profile to create 3D geometry.
label.translation: Creates text inside a rectangular frame or along a selected path, which you can use as a profile to create 3D geometry.

label.devLabel: Place the text frame or select the path for text to follow, then enter and format your text.
label.translation: Place the text frame or select the path for text to follow, then enter and format your text.

label.devLabel: Sets the orientation of the texture applied to the body or component.
label.translation: Sets the orientation of the texture applied to the body or component.

label.devLabel: Select the object to modify then the Projection Type and the Axis. Modify the Mapping Transform using the manipulator or fields in the dialog.
label.translation: Select the object to modify then the Projection Type and the Axis. Modify the Mapping Transform using the manipulator or fields in the dialog.

label.devLabel: Use Projection Type to control how the texture is wrapped onto the body or component. Use the Mapping Transform to control the position of the texture.
label.translation: Use Projection Type to control how the texture is wrapped onto the body or component. Use the Mapping Transform to control the position of the texture.

label.devLabel: Select the object to modify then the Projection Type and the Axis. Modify the Mapping Transform usimg the manipulator or fields in the dialog.
label.translation: Select the object to modify then the Projection Type and the Axis. Modify the Mapping Transform usimg the manipulator or fields in the dialog.

label.devLabel: Add internal or external threads to cylindrical geometry. Threads can be cosmetic or modeled on the geometry.
label.translation: Add internal or external threads to cylindrical geometry. Threads can be cosmetic or modeled on the geometry.

label.devLabel: Select a cylindrical face then set the thread specifications.
label.translation: Select a cylindrical face then set the thread specifications.

label.devLabel: Creates a tangent relationship between a face on a body in one component and a set of connected faces on a body in another component within an assembly.
label.translation: Creates a tangent relationship between a face on a body in one component and a set of connected faces on a body in another component within an assembly.

label.devLabel: Select a face on a body in the first component, then select a face on a body in the second component. The selected faces maintain a positional relationship tangent to each other.
label.translation: Select a face on a body in the first component, then select a face on a body in the second component. The selected faces maintain a positional relationship tangent to each other.

label.devLabel: Select the faces that you want to maintain tangency to enhance the motion of the jointed assembly.
label.translation: Select the faces that you want to maintain tangency to enhance the motion of the jointed assembly.

label.devLabel: Add joints first, then define tangent relationships.
label.translation: Add joints first, then define tangent relationships.

label.devLabel: Trims a sketch curve to the nearest intersecting curve or boundary geometry.
label.translation: Trims a sketch curve to the nearest intersecting curve or boundary geometry.

label.devLabel: Pause the cursor over the curve to preview the portion to be trimmed. Select the curve to trim.
label.translation: Pause the cursor over the curve to preview the portion to be trimmed. Select the curve to trim.

label.devLabel: Displays a list of changes made to the current assembly and its external references.
label.translation: Displays a list of changes made to the current assembly and its external references.

label.devLabel: Select a component to highlight it in the canvas.
label.translation: Select a component to highlight it in the canvas.

label.devLabel: Unsupported file format! Please try the SAT or STEP format file.
label.translation: Unsupported file format! Please try the SAT or STEP format file.

label.devLabel: Creates a custom coordinate system that you can reference in assembly relationships, manufacturing setups or other downstream workflows.
label.translation: Creates a custom coordinate system that you can reference in assembly relationships, manufacturing setups or other downstream workflows.

label.devLabel: Select a Snap point on a component to place the coordinate system. Optionally, adjust its position, orientation, and axis alignment.
label.translation: Select a Snap point on a component to place the coordinate system. Optionally, adjust its position, orientation, and axis alignment.

label.devLabel: It is also possible to use Axis Alignment to have the Coordinate System align with specific model features.
label.translation: It is also possible to use Axis Alignment to have the Coordinate System align with specific model features.

label.devLabel:
Choose the snap point for the coordinate system.

Then adjust the angle and offset from the original position.
label.translation:
Choose the snap point for the coordinate system.

Then adjust the angle and offset from the original position.

label.devLabel: Displays each component in an assembly as a different color to make them easier to differentiate. Hides physical materials and appearances.
label.translation: Displays each component in an assembly as a different color to make them easier to differentiate. Hides physical materials and appearances.

label.devLabel: Press Shift+N to show or hide component colors in the canvas. Right-click a component and select Cycle Component Color to change its color.
label.translation: Press Shift+N to show or hide component colors in the canvas. Right-click a component and select Cycle Component Color to change its color.

label.translation: Creates a construction axis from selected linear edge or sketch curve.

label.translation: Select a linear edge, axis, or sketch curve.

label.translation: In Parametric Modeling mode, edit the axis feature in the timeline to change the position. In Direct Modeling mode, use the Move/Copy command to change the position.

label.translation: Creates a construction axis, perpendicular to a surface or plane, at a selected point.

label.translation: Select a face or sketch profile, then select a point.

Reference it in a local parameter expression

Невозможно настроить этот параметр, так как он

параметр в исходном дизайне.

configure it.

Невозможно настроить этот размер, так как он
является управляемым.

Переключите управляемый размер в ведущий,
чтобы настроить его.

Cannot configure this parameter because
Axis 2 is not selected in the pattern.

Select an Axis 2 direction to enable
configuration of these parameters.

Параметр оси 2 не настраивается

Невозможно настроить этот параметр,
потому что ось 2 не выбрана в массиве.

Выберите направление оси 2,
чтобы включить настройку этих параметров.

label.devLabel:
Feature Parameter Not Configurable

Cannot configure this Feature Parameter because the feature that created it has been deleted.
label.translation:
Параметр функции не настраивается

Невозможно настроить этот параметр функции, так как функция, которая его создала, была удалена.

label.devLabel:
Pattern Quantity Not Configurable

Cannot configure this Pattern Quantity
because it references a Driven Dimension.

Toggle the Diriven Dimension to Driving or
remove it from the expression to configure
this parameter.
label.translation:
Количество в массиве не настраивается

Невозможно настроить количество в массиве,
так как оно ссылается на зависимый размер.

Измените зависимый размер на ведущий или
удалите его из выражения, чтобы настроить
этот параметр.

label.devLabel:
Sheet Metal Thickness Not Configurable

Cannot configure this parameter because it is
driven by its Sheet Metal Rule.

Configure the Sheet Metal Rule applied to a
component to vary sheet metal thickness.
label.translation:
Толщина листового металла не настраивается

Невозможно настроить этот параметр, так как он
определяется Правилом листового металла.

Настройте Правило листового металла, примененное к
компоненту, для изменения толщины листового металла.
